jobs.title: Project Coordinator IV, Sustainability
jobs.description:
**The Work**

LACCD is spending bond money to cut energy use and carbon across its nine college campuses: solar, battery storage, microgrids, electric vehicle charging, new building controls, LED lighting, upgraded central plants, and swapping gas equipment for electric. The Sustainability Strike Team runs those projects. You are the person who keeps their money straight.

You work under the Sustainability Strike Team Lead, alongside the team's Cost Analyst and project managers. You help set up each new project with a budget, a funding check, and a cost estimate, then track it through design, construction, and closeout: forecasts, estimates to complete, change order requests, contract balances, invoices, and the monthly reconciliation. When the money looks like it will run short or a funding issue could hold up a contract, you see it first and say so.

This is a good seat for a cost analyst, project controls specialist, or project coordinator from a public capital program who is very strong in Excel and has worked in a project management system like Proliance or Trimble Unity. Energy or sustainability work helps, but it is not required.

**What You Will Do**

* Give day-to-day project coordination, cost management, and financial controls support to the Strike Team Cost Analyst, the project managers, and the Sustainability Strike Team
* Help set up new projects and write their white papers: financial documents, funding checks, early budgets, cost estimates, and reviews, following the program office's standard procedures
* Check project budgets, available funding, estimates, and forecasts with District staff, college project teams, the program office, and program controls
* Build and keep cost forecasts and estimates to complete, and track change order requests, commitments, and available funding
* Watch budgets, spending, contract balances, money set aside but not yet spent, and funding risks, so a shortfall shows up before it affects the project
* Do the monthly budget and cost reconciliations across more than one funding source
* Work with the schedulers on cash flow and on how schedule changes affect cost
* Review financial reports and progress data, and tell the project managers about material variances and risks
* Track contract periods of performance, contract balances, and remaining funding
* Coordinate invoice review and reconciliation with accounting so payments go out on time and correct
* Keep the program controls databases, dashboards, and financial reports accurate
* Keep project documents, records, correspondence, and reports organized and current

  
**Requirements**

**What You Bring**

* 5 recent years in engineering, project management, sustainability, project controls, cost management, or a related field (required for this role)
* A bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, sustainability, or a related field. Another way to qualify: 4 more years of the same experience, 9 years in all, takes the place of the degree
* Advanced Excel: complex formulas, pivot tables, data analysis, financial models, budget tracking, and reports (required for this role)
* Microsoft Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint
* A large project management software system such as Proliance or Trimble Unity, or one like them (required for this role)
* Clear writing, careful analysis, good organization, and the ability to keep several projects and many people moving on your own

**Preferred**

* Capital projects inside a large public works or school construction program
* Cost management, forecasting, estimates to complete, and funding checks
* BuildLACCD or a similar program's financial controls, budgets, and project setup
* The DSA process (DSA is the state office that approves public school and college construction)
* Energy efficiency, renewable energy, electrification, or other sustainability projects
* Tableau or a similar tool for cost and performance reports

  
**Benefits**

**Compensation**

Salary range: $128,000 to $140,000 per year, based on experience.

Benefits: health, dental, and vision at low cost; 401k; three weeks of PTO; and an ESOP (employee stock ownership) at no cost to you, with a 3% Safe Harbor contribution vested on day one.

**Why MAAS**

MAAS has spent nearly 40 years earning the trust of 50+ educational institutions across California, managing over $10B in projects. That track record means the work here is stable, funded, and consequential. You are not chasing the next contract.

As a MAAS employee, you are also an owner. The company is 100% employee-owned through an ESOP, a retirement benefit provided at no cost to you, on top of your salary. MAAS is a profitable, well-run organization and our share price has more than doubled since the plan's inception, with continued growth year over year. Your ownership stake builds the longer you stay, and ESOP participants nationally tend to accumulate 2.5x more in retirement savings than employees at non-ESOP companies.

In an industry not known for prioritizing culture, 96% of MAAS employees say it is a great place to work, and 100% say people genuinely care about each other.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator IV - Sustainability
jobs.description:
**Position Description**:  
  
The Project Coordinator IV – Sustainability provides project coordination, cost management, and financial controls support to the BuildLACCD Sustainability Strike Team throughout the planning, scoping, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout of sustainability and energy related capital improvement projects across the Los Angeles Community College District (LACCD).  
  
Working under the direction of the Sustainability Strike Team Lead, this position supports the Strike Team Cost Analyst, Project Managers and coordinates with District personnel, Campus Administration, College Project Teams (CPTs), Program Management Office (PMO), Program Controls, and other stakeholders to support project budget development, funding verification, cost forecasting, financial reporting, and project establishment.  
  
The position supports Districtwide sustainability initiatives, including Energy Information Systems (EIS), Sustainability and Climate Action Roadmap, Building Management Systems (BMS), Central Plant and Local Building Decarbonization, Central Plant optimization, LED lighting upgrades, energy efficiency retrofits, renewable energy systems, Photovoltaic (PV), microgrids, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure, electrification, and other sustainability-related capital improvement projects.

* Provide day-to-day project coordination, cost management, and financial controls support to Strike Team Cost Analyst, Project Managers, and the Sustainability Strike Team throughout the project lifecycle.
* Prepare, organize, and maintain project management documents, records, correspondence, reports, and other project-related communications.
* Support project establishment and White Paper development by coordinating financial documentation, funding verification, preliminary budgets, cost estimates, and required reviews in accordance with established BuildLACCD PMO Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Coordinate with District personnel, CPTs, PMO, Program Controls, and other stakeholders to verify project budgets, available funding, cost estimates, forecasts, and financial requirements.
* Coordinate with CPTs and PMO Cost Analysts to support budget establishment, monitoring, budget transfers, and accurate financial reporting.
* Develop and maintain cost forecasts and Estimates-to-Complete (ETCs); track Change Order Requests (CORs), commitments, and funding availability.
* Monitor project budgets, expenditures, contract balances, remaining encumbrances, funding availability, and financial risks to identify potential shortfalls before they affect project delivery.
* Work with PMO Cost Analysts to verify the accuracy and integrity of project budgets and financial forecasts in accordance with established cost management procedures.
* Participate in change management and risk assessment meetings to identify cost-related trends, risks, exposures, and potential mitigation strategies.
* Perform monthly budget and cost reconciliations to support accurate month-end reporting and review expenditures across multiple funding sources.
* Coordinate with scheduling teams to assess cash flow and schedule performance impacts on costs, including variances, overruns, underruns, and forecasting concerns.
* Review financial reports, cost performance, and progress data; communicate material variances and potential financial risks to Project Managers and appropriate stakeholders.
* Track contract Periods of Performance (POP), contract balances, remaining encumbrances, and available funding. Coordinate invoice oversight and reconciliation with accounting and project stakeholders to support timely and accurate payment processing.
* Collaborate with PMO to validate project budget data, support stakeholder dashboards, and maintain accurate program controls databases and financial reports.
* Gather physical completion data and coordinate updates to project budget and forecast records as appropriate. Proactively identify funding issues that could delay procurement, contract execution, project initiation, or other critical activities.
* Support compliance with applicable District requirements, BuildLACCD PMO SOPs, cost management procedures, and bond funding requirements throughout project development and implementation.
* Perform other bond-eligible project cost management and coordination duties as directed by the Sustainability Strike Team Lead.

**Minimum Required Qualifications:**

* Minimum of five (5) years of recent professional experience in engineering, project management, sustainability, project controls, cost management, and/or a related field.
* BS/BA degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Sustainability, or a related field. Four additional years of qualifying experience beyond the minimum experience requirement may be substituted for the required education. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data analysis, financial modeling, budget tracking, and reporting.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Proficiency with enterprise-level Project Management Information Systems (PMIS), such as Proliance, Trimble Unity, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong writing, analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, coordinate with diverse stakeholders, and manage multiple project priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting capital improvement projects within large public works or educational facility construction programs.
* Experience with project cost management, forecasting, Estimate-to-Complete (ETC) development, and funding verification.
* Familiarity with BuildLACCD or similar capital improvement program financial controls, budget management, and project establishment processes.
* Familiarity with Division of the State Architect (DSA) design and construction processe

jobs.title: HUMAN TRAFFICKING COORDINATOR (PROGRAM SPECIALIST)
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The City Manager’s Office is recruiting for a full-time, unclassified Human Trafficking Coordinator (Program Specialist). Under the supervision of the Deputy City Manager for Strategic Governance and Policy, this position will establish and lead the City’s new human trafficking and sexual exploitation focus area, addressing both sex and labor trafficking. It will also serve as the City’s centralized lead for implementing the R.E.A.C.T. Framework (Report, Economic Investment, Advocate, Community Budget, TriCity Partnership and LA County), coordinating interdepartmental and interjurisdictional efforts to address human trafficking along Long Beach Boulevard, citywide, and across the region.

This is a new position added in the FY 27 Budget and the City’s only position dedicated full time to addressing human trafficking. The position will work closely with City departments involved in this work, as well as community partners, service providers, and regional agencies, to coordinate efforts, strengthen partnerships, and make better use of data. The City Manager’s Office is responsible for the administration of all City government departments, except for elected offices and the semi-autonomous departments. This is a rewarding opportunity for a highly organized, self-motivated leader who can bring people together, build partnerships, and turn data into action in a fast-paced environment.

**EXAMPLES OF DUTIES**
----------------------

* Serve as the City’s centralized lead and point of contact for implementation of the R.E.A.C.T. Framework and related interdepartmental and interjurisdictional anti-human trafficking efforts
* Convene and facilitate the City’s interdepartmental Anti-Human Trafficking Team, including setting agendas, tracking commitments, and following up on and supporting action items
* Work with partner departments, including Police, Health and Human Services, Community Development, the City Prosecutor, and the City Attorney, to develop work plans, timelines, and accountability measures, and to support related policies, programs, and ordinances
* Lead the development and implementation of City initiatives, such as public awareness campaigns and community workshops, including managing consultants and contracts, scopes of work and deliverables
* Identify gaps, overlaps, and barriers across City efforts, research promising practices from other jurisdictions, and recommend practical solutions to City leadership
* Inventory and assess data collected by the City and its partners, and recommend improvements to data collection, sharing, and analysis
* Develop performance measures, analyze trends, and track the progress and outcomes of City efforts
* Prepare clear reports, memos, City Council items, and presentations for City leadership, the City Council, and the public
* Ensure the perspectives of survivors and people with lived experience inform City strategy, using a trauma-informed, survivor-centered approach
* Build and sustain partnerships and coalitions with nonprofits, survivor-serving organizations, community groups, businesses, schools, and faith-based organizations
* Coordinate with neighboring cities, Los Angeles County, regional and local human trafficking task forces, and State and Federal partners on shared strategies
* In coordination with the Office of Government Affairs (OGA), track State and Federal legislation and funding opportunities related to human trafficking and help develop recommended City positions
* Identify grant opportunities and assist with grant applications, administration, and reporting
* Manage the program budget, track expenditures, resources, and funding sources, and ensure funds are used effectively and in compliance with City requirements
* Represent the City at community meetings, task forces, and public events
* Respond to City Council and community inquiries related to the City’s anti-human trafficking efforts
* May assist with other related duties

**REQUIREMENTS TO FILE**
------------------------

**EDUCATION**

* A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university with a major in Public Administration, Public Policy, Social Work, Criminal Justice, Public Health, Political Science, or a related field \*must provide proof of degree. OR
* Experience offering specific and substantial preparation for the duties of the position may be substituted for the required education on a year-for-year basis.

**EXPERIENCE**

* Two (2) years of full-time equivalent professional experience in program coordination, policy development, or community partnerships, preferably in public safety, public health, social services, or local government.
* A Master’s Degree in one of the preceding fields may be substituted for one year of the required experience. \*must provide proof of degree

Required documents, such as transcripts and degrees, must be uploaded to the online application in PDF format at the time of filing. Any proofs submitted must contain either the applicant’s name or other identifying characteristics on the document.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE**

The ideal candidate is a skilled organizer, facilitator, and leader with the people savvy to bring departments and partners together around shared goals and keep complex work moving forward. They understand that partner departments carry full workloads and know how to support them by researching, drafting, and taking on the execution of shared efforts where appropriate. They will bring a track record of moving multi-agency or multidisciplinary initiatives from plan to results, along with the relationship-building skills to earn the trust of City departments, elected officials, nonprofits, survivors, and community members alike.

As this is a new position, the ideal candidate will be energized by building a program from the ground up. They are highly organized, self-directed, and proactive. They set priorities, track their own progress, keep leadership informed, and push work forward with

jobs.title: Faculty Support and Academic Program Coordinator, Office of Faculty Support and Academic Success Program
jobs.description:
Founded in 1896, the Gould School of Law has a distinguished past built on the principles of equity and excellence, and the courage to break new ground. USC first introduced legal education in Southern California. Today, the Law School continues to make history through its philosophy of innovation and through its people. USC Gould cultivates analytical ability, ethical values, and a spirit of collegiality that prepare students for meaningful careers benefiting society. It was one of the first law schools to engage students in clinical programs and remains a leader in experiential education.

The Gould School of Law is seeking to hire a Faculty Support Coordinator to join the Office of Faculty Support and support the Academic Success Program. This position will report to the Director of Faculty Support, and will assist a number of faculty with their research and teaching needs. The number of faculty assigned may vary throughout the year

**ATTENTION:** This position is full-time, benefits-eligible, and 1-year fixed term. Applicants must upload a cover letter and a resume to be considered for this position.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Preferred Education: Bachelor's degree in legal studies
* Preferred Experience: Experience in higher education

**Job Accountabilities:**

  

This position involves a variety of administrative tasks that include, but are not limited to, the following:

**50% Faculty Support**

  

* Directly completes work assignments from professors, including scanning and making photocopies, drafting and formatting letters of recommendation for students, proofreading and editing documents, ordering supplies, answering incoming calls and emails, managing and coordinating schedules.
* Helps prepare course materials, coordinates exams, takes class attendance, assists in the ordering of textbooks and additional resources, organizes and edits PowerPoint presentations, spreadsheets, and classroom handouts.
* Posts assignments, announcements, and readings to Brightspace, records grades, releases class recordings, and oversees other relevant course content.
* Arranges travel and parking reservations for faculty and guest speakers.
* Processes reimbursement requests for faculty travel and other university expenses.
* Sorts and sends mail, letters, and packages.
* Assists in event planning, including reserving meeting spaces, ordering catering, setting up rooms, coordinating speaking engagements for law professors, and other logistical needs.
* Lends classroom support to faculty to ensure that they know how to operate audio-visual equipment. Helps troubleshoot any IT issues.
* Files and/or transcribes legal documents.
* Will assist with both final exam administration and proctoring at the end of the Fall and Spring semesters and commencement each year.
* Perform other related duties as assigned or requested. The university reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

**50% Academic Success Program (ASP):**

Gould’s ASP is a comprehensive program that assists JD students from admission to law school through admission to the bar. This means that ASP has programming, communications, events, and services on a 12-month schedule. The ASP is staffed by its director and associate director (both of whom are Gould faculty members), six ASP Fellows (who are upper division law students), and two Alumni Bar Coaches (who are recent Gould graduates). The program looks forward to welcoming a dedicated Faculty Support Coordinator to help with many tasks, including but not limited to those listed below. There will be other duties related to the program that are assigned or requested on an ad hoc basis and as the program changes.

The ASP Support Coordinator will also work with the faculty to create systems to make all of the ASP administrative tasks more routine and efficient, including developing ASP calendaring systems, tracking student communications, and creating instructions for how to complete required administrative tasks.

The ASP Support Coordinator will deal with students and with sensitive student data (including GPA data). As such, the ASP Support Coordinator must be highly respectful of confidentiality and privacy concerns.

It will be important for the ASP Support Coordinator to be present, on-campus dependably on at least three days per week, and on other days as needed. For example, the ASP Support Coordinator will be expected to be on campus on ASP workshop days, and during summer programs including the simulated bar exam (early July), Gould Preview (early-to-mid August), and Orientation (mid-August).

The administrative responsibilities of the ASP Support Coordinator include both those listed above under Faculty Support and the following, which is a non-exhaustive list:

  

* Creating, updating, and disseminating flyers and other publicity to promote ASP events
* Scheduling rooms and communications with other departments (often having to reschedule rooms at last minute because of double-booked events)
* Ordering and delivering food for ASP events and workshops
* Creating and administering surveys for a variety of purposes including surveys to evaluate the ASP’s events, workshops, courses, and other programs
* Updating content and posting announcements on the ASP Brightspace page

Anderson Bradshaw Consulting is an established tax resolution firm helping individuals and businesses navigate serious IRS and tax problems. Our sales and service teams work together to help clients understand their next steps and move forward with their tax matters.

Your day will combine live phone coverage with proactive outreach and lead coordination. Incoming calls take priority; between calls, you will work CRM leads, follow up with salespeople, and recover opportunities that have stalled or gone untouched.

**What You’ll Do**

* Answer incoming calls promptly, identify the caller’s needs, and transfer live sales inquiries to available salespeople.

* Call, text, and email older or unresponsive prospects to reestablish interest and connect renewed opportunities with the sales team.
* Identify neglected or stalled leads, personally follow up, and coordinate reassignment with the Director of Sales’ approval.
* Maintain accurate contact information, lead ownership, statuses, notes, and follow-up tasks in the CRM.
* Document outreach attempts and client responses so each opportunity has a clear next step.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Experience in sales coordination, sales support, a call center, or phone-based customer service. Two or more years preferred.
* A professional phone presence, strong listening skills, and clear verbal and written communication.
* Confidence making outbound follow-up calls and reconnecting with previously contacted prospects.
* Comfort using a CRM to manage contact records, notes, lead statuses, and follow-up tasks.
* Strong organization, accurate data entry, and the ability to switch between incoming calls and ongoing follow-up without losing track of details.
* A proactive approach to identifying missed opportunities and following through on outstanding items.
* Comfort communicating with clients about sensitive matters and handling their information discreetly.
* A coachable approach and the ability to follow established call and CRM procedures.
* Dependable attendance and availability to work in person Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.

Experience in tax resolution, financial services, legal intake, insurance, or a similar professional-services setting is a plus. Relevant experience and practical phone and CRM skills are prioritized; a college degree is not required.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Starting base salary of $60,000–$65,000 per year, based on relevant experience.
* Health, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) with company match.
* Paid time off.
* Paid holidays.
* A consistent Monday–Friday office schedule.
* Direct collaboration with the Director of Sales and an established sales team.

Benefits are subject to applicable eligibility requirements and plan terms.

**Who Succeeds Here**

You are comfortable being the person who keeps things moving. You communicate professionally with callers, notice when a lead needs attention, and follow through until the next step is clear. You enjoy supporting a sales team and turning an unanswered inquiry or an older CRM record into a live conversation.

Apply through Indeed with your resume highlighting your phone experience, CRM skills, and lead follow-up responsibilities.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Content Creator – Strategy & Creative Execution
jobs.description:
**Pay:** $28.00–$35.00 per hour (Based on experience and portfolio)

About the Position

We are a growing B2C e-commerce company specializing in lifestyle products, looking for a creative and results-driven **Digital Marketing Content Creator** who can turn marketing ideas into actual campaigns that generate sales.

**We are not looking for someone who only takes photos, edits videos, or designs graphics.**

We need someone who understands marketing, can come up with creative ideas, plan how and where the content should be used, and personally create the banners, videos, graphics, and other marketing materials needed to bring those ideas to life.

For example, when we launch a new product or promotion, we want someone who can develop the marketing concept, decide what content is needed for our website, social media, paid advertising, and email campaigns, then take ownership of creating and executing those materials.

You should be equally comfortable **thinking like a marketer and working like a content creator.**

Key Responsibilities

**Marketing Strategy & Creative Planning**

* Develop creative marketing ideas for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and ongoing brand awareness.
* Plan how to promote products across our website, social media, paid advertising, and email marketing.
* Identify what types of banners, videos, images, and other content are needed for each marketing campaign.
* Understand customer behavior and create marketing content designed to attract attention, communicate product benefits, and generate sales.
* Research competitors, marketing trends, and successful campaigns to identify new opportunities.
* Take ownership of marketing projects from initial idea through execution and performance review.

**Hands-On Content Creation**

* Personally create marketing banners, promotional graphics, product videos, short-form videos, and social media content.
* Develop content for website homepages, collection pages, promotional campaigns, Meta Ads, email marketing, and social media.
* Shoot and edit videos or photos when needed.
* Create different creative variations for testing and improving marketing performance.
* Use graphic design, video editing, and other creative tools to turn marketing ideas into finished content.
* Maintain consistent branding and messaging across all marketing channels.

**Social Media & Paid Advertising**

* Plan and execute organic content strategies for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
* Create content that encourages engagement, attracts potential customers, and drives traffic to our website.
* Develop advertising concepts and creatives for Meta Ads.
* Understand how ad creatives influence click-through rates, conversions, and return on ad spend (ROAS).
* Monitor content performance and make improvements based on results.

**Email & Website Marketing**

* Develop creative ideas for email promotions, product launches, and seasonal campaigns.
* Create email banners, promotional graphics, and marketing messages.
* Understand how to segment audiences and create relevant campaigns.
* Plan website banners and promotional content based on marketing priorities.
* Coordinate messaging and creative materials across the website, email, social media, and paid advertising.

Qualifications

* 2–3 years of experience in digital marketing, e-commerce marketing, or marketing-focused content creation.
* Strong creative thinking with the ability to develop marketing ideas independently.
* Experience planning and executing marketing campaigns, not just producing creative assets.
* Hands-on ability to create marketing banners, graphics, videos, and social media content.
* Experience with tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar.
* Understanding of Meta Ads, social media marketing, and email marketing.
* Familiarity with e-commerce websites and how marketing content influences online sales.
* Ability to explain why certain content should be created, where it should be placed, and what marketing goal it should accomplish.
* Comfortable analyzing campaign results and making improvements.
* Self-motivated, organized, and able to manage projects from idea to completion.
* Open to feedback and able to work collaboratively with the marketing team.
* Experience with Shopify and Klaviyo is a plus.
* Experience working with consumer brands or e-commerce businesses is preferred.

**Portfolio Required:** Please provide examples of marketing campaigns or content you have personally planned and created. We are especially interested in seeing your creative ideas, how you executed them, and the results they achieved.

What We're Looking For

We want someone who doesn't wait to be told exactly what to create.

When we have a new product, promotion, or marketing opportunity, you should be able to come to the team with ideas such as:

* "We should create a product comparison video to help customers understand the differences."
* "This promotion needs a homepage banner, three Meta Ad variations, and an email campaign."
* "Our competitors are using this type of content successfully. Here's how we can create something better."
* "This campaign isn't converting well. Let's test a different message, visual, or video concept."

Most importantly, **you should be able to turn those ideas into finished marketing materials yourself**, rather than only recommending what others should create.

We value creativity, initiative, practical marketing knowledge, and the ability to get things done.

What We Offer

* $28.00–$35.00 per hour, based on experience and portfolio.
* Performance-based salary reviews.
* Career growth opportunities.
* Opportunity to work with multiple consumer brands.
* Freedom to contribute creative ideas and take ownership of marketing projects.
* Collaborative working environment.
* Opportunities to make a measurable impact on company sales and growth.
* Overtime opportunities during

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Logistics Coordinator is responsible for coordinating, monitoring, tracking, and documenting all inbound, outbound, and interfacility logistics activities at PureTek Corporation. This position ensures the timely, accurate, cost-effective, and compliant movement of raw materials, packaging components, equipment, supplies, work-in-process materials, and finished products among PureTek's manufacturing facilities, suppliers, customers, warehouses, and third-party logistics providers. Serving as the central point of contact for shipment activities, the Logistics Coordinator maintains end-to-end visibility of transportation schedules, shipment status, delivery performance, documentation, and logistics-related issues. The position works closely with Purchasing, Planning, Warehouse, Production, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Customer Service, and external transportation providers to support operational efficiency and compliance with company procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Inbound, Outbound, and Interfacility Logistics**

* Coordinate and monitor incoming shipments of raw materials, packaging components, equipment, supplies, and other purchased materials, as well as outbound shipments of finished goods to customers, distributors, warehouses, and designated destinations.
* Coordinate transportation and material transfers between PureTek's Nelson and Arroyo manufacturing facilities, including raw materials, packaging components, bulk products, work-in-process materials, and finished goods.
* Communicate with suppliers, Purchasing, freight carriers, Warehouse, Planning, Production, Quality Assurance, and Customer Service to confirm shipment schedules, material availability, shipment readiness, delivery requirements, and expected delivery dates.
* Arrange transportation through approved carriers and third-party logistics providers, coordinating pickup, transit, delivery, and receiving schedules to minimize delays, congestion, and operational disruptions.
* Ensure outbound products have the required QA release or documented authorization before dispatch.
* Monitor shipments from supplier dispatch or facility departure through final delivery, identifying and resolving delays, shortages, damages, quantity discrepancies, missed pickups, and delivery exceptions.
* Obtain and maintain required shipping and transfer documentation, including packing lists, bills of lading, certificates, proof of delivery (POD), material identification, lot information when applicable, and traceability records.
* Ensure interfacility transfers are properly documented in applicable inventory management systems and investigate discrepancies between dispatched and received quantities.
* Provide timely shipment status updates to internal departments and authorized customers.

**B. Shipment Tracking, Inventory, and Warehouse Coordination**

* Establish and maintain a centralized logistics tracking system covering all inbound, outbound, and interfacility shipments, monitoring open shipments through final delivery confirmation and resolution of outstanding issues.
* Maintain accurate shipment records, including shipment reference numbers, suppliers or customers, product/material descriptions, carriers and tracking information, origins and destinations, scheduled pickup dates, expected and actual delivery dates, shipment status, transportation costs, exceptions, and corrective actions.
* Monitor shipment status daily, including pending receipts, outstanding deliveries, unconfirmed shipments, and transportation exceptions; provide daily updates and escalate issues that may affect manufacturing schedules, customer commitments, or product quality.
* Coordinate shipment priorities with Warehouse, Planning, and Production based on production schedules, customer requirements, and material availability.
* Verify shipment quantities and product identification against applicable shipping documents and coordinate loading, unloading, staging, and shipment preparation with warehouse personnel.
* Support inventory reconciliation for materials in transit and report logistics-related inventory discrepancies to the appropriate departments.
* Maintain shipment records and supporting documentation in accordance with company procedures.

**C. Transportation and Freight Management**

* Coordinate freight arrangements with approved transportation companies, couriers, and third-party logistics providers; obtain and compare freight quotations to identify cost-effective transportation options.
* Monitor freight charges, verify invoices against approved quotations, shipment records, and applicable contractual rates, and identify opportunities to reduce transportation costs.
* Coordinate special transportation requirements, including temperature-controlled shipments when applicable, and expedited shipments when necessary, obtaining required management approval.
* Monitor carrier performance, including pickup reliability, transit times, delivery accuracy, and damage rates; support transportation provider evaluations and recommend improvements in logistics efficiency.
* Evaluate opportunities to consolidate interfacility transfers and reduce unnecessary transportation expenses.

**D. Quality and Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure logistics activities comply with applicable PureTek SOPs, GMP requirements, distribution procedures, and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with Quality Assurance regarding shipment release status, damaged materials, transportation excursions, and other quality-related concerns. Ensure quarantined, rejected, or restricted materials are not shipped without appropriate authorization.
* Support product traceability by maintaining accurate shipping, receiving, transfer, and lot records, as applicable.
* Coordinate with Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance regarding applicable Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA) requirements.

**About Vector Atomic:**

Vector Atomic, an IonQ company, is building quantum technology to transform navigation, timing, geophysical exploration, and telecommunications. Our team of engineers, scientists, software developers, and operations professionals works together to solve complex challenges and turn bold ideas into real-world solutions. We value collaboration, curiosity, and diverse perspectives, and we give every team member the opportunity to make an immediate impact while growing their skills. If you're excited to work on breakthrough technology in a fast-paced, hands-on environment, we'd love to hear from you.

To support challenging technical goals, you will take ownership of, and create streamlined processes for, management, tracking, and delivery of programmatic requirements. Working closely with executive leadership and the overall team, your responsibilities will include: (a) program support for Principal Investigators, including report creation and submission, project scheduling/tracking, and program management; (b) taking possession of contract review and administration; (c) distill and convey complex ideas to technical and general audiences; (d) adding structure and efficient processes to our organization while maintaining our get-it-done culture. jobs.title: Program Coordinator - YAWL Young Adult Job Centers
jobs.description:
**JOB ANNOUNCEMENT**

The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. Our mission is to encourage a diverse population of high-need young people to explore their full potential through academic, career, family, and community life.  
  
**Title:****Program Coordinator - YAWL Young Adult Job Centers**

**Salary:****$30.00 - $34.00 per hour plus excellent benefits**

**Reports to:****Program Supervisor**

**Status:****Full-Time, (40 hours/week), Non-Exempt**  
  
**Program Summary:** CYC’s YAWL Workforce Development Program provides job readiness and employment support services to youth ages 16-24. The program offers 1:1 job search and career coaching, work based learning internships, college and career exploration, and job shadowing opportunities to propel youth and young adults to be ready for college, work and reach productive adulthood.  
  
**Position Description:** Under the supervision of the Program Supervisor, the Program Coordinator is responsible for overseeing the Young Adult Job Center portfolio, supervising staff, overseeing workshops/trainings, establishing best practice program models, and providing high quality youth workforce and development services.  
  
**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Oversee the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Young Adult Work Link program and comprehensive service delivery model.
* Develop policy and procedure recommendations to strengthen the program model and collaboration among grantee and coalition partners.
* Ensure program development and service delivery align with “Youth Program Quality Standards” and meet all “Work Plan” deliverables and deadlines.
* Complete all required documentation, reports, and program deliverables in a timely manner.
* Lead citywide outreach and recruitment efforts, cultivating strategic community partnerships and developing a robust referral network to support recruitment and engagement, with a focus on priority populations.
* Conduct participant assessments and provide intensive case management, wraparound supportive services, and guidance to address barriers affecting work and school performance.
* Develop individualized vocational goals and career plans using vocational and interest assessments, and provide personal and career guidance.
* Develop and facilitate job readiness training workshops, including but not limited to professionalism, career exploration, resume and cover letter building, job search/navigation, interview skill development, mock interviews, and strength/talent identification.
* Coordinate GED attainment, tutoring, basic skills remediation, postsecondary education, and workforce training services.
* Provide 1:1 career guidance and assist participants with individualized education and career planning services, job search and placement assistance and conduct follow ups for retention services.
* Connect participants to resources within CYC and other CBO or city services for barrier removal to ensure their success.
* Supervise, support, coach and train Program Specialists in job readiness training content, career counseling, outreach, funder databases, and other duties as applicable.
* Collaborate with the workforce team to strategize on program planning, development and implementation of overall youth workforce development programs and outcomes.
* Coordinate career exploration events and adult mentoring opportunities such as worksite/company tours, college tours, and networking events for program participants
* Cultivate relationships with employers, developing jobs for youth and young adults.
* Support agency-wide events and perform other duties as assigned by management.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in relevant field.
* Experience working with diverse youth backgrounds, preferably within youth workforce development programs.
* Previous experience in program coordination and development.
* Ability to work with ethnically diverse groups of low-income youth as well as English learners to support their social and emotional needs during transition.
* At least 1 year of experience supervising a team of three or more staff.
* Experience working with San Francisco's diverse communities and neighborhoods.
* Experience working with community-based service providers and private sector partners.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Zoom, and other technology platforms.
* Experience facilitating workshops for youth and young adults.
* Ability to work as part of a team, to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and to work independently in a high-pressure environment.
* Bilingual in Cantonese/Mandarin/Spanish and English is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to work some evenings and weekends.
* Enthusiasm for promoting academic achievement and college education.
* Able to lift or move at least 25lbs

CYC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, age, religion, gender, marital status, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other basis recognized by federal, state, or local law, including on the basis of the intersection of two or more protected characteristics, also known as intersectional discrimination. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.

jobs.company: California Association of Public Hospitals and Health Systems
jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
The California Health Care Safety Net Institute (SNI) partners with California’s public health care systems to optimize and transform the ecosystem of care, providing high-quality, patient-led, and equitable care for all. Together with our advocacy partner, the California Association of Public Hospitals and Health Systems, SNI works to strengthen care delivery systems by shaping the policies and programs that drive improvement and creating a community where system leaders can exchange ideas and advance shared priorities.

SNI and CAPH represent California’s 17 public health care systems, which include the county-owned or affiliated systems and the University of California academic medical centers. These systems serve as the foundation of the state’s safety net, delivering care to all who need it, regardless of insurance coverage, immigration status, ability to pay, or other circumstances. Public health care systems primarily serve people from historically marginalized communities, including persons of color, individuals experiencing financial hardship or homelessness, and individuals with complex health and social needs.

Although SNI and CAPH are separate legal entities, they function day-to-day as a matrix organization, with SNI contributing to CAPH’s policy and advocacy efforts, CAPH offering technical expertise to SNI’s programs, and the organizations working together to achieve shared goals for our member systems.

SNI and CAPH are committed to advancing equity and serve as an Equal Opportunity Employer with a strong commitment to racial, cultural, and ethnic diversity. Qualified applicants of all races, people with all abilities, and veterans are encouraged to apply.

**SNI’s Programs**

SNI brings together systems’ leaders from clinical, quality, data, finance, and operational areas through in-person and virtual convenings, communities of practice, webinars, and our CAPH/SNI Annual Conference. By creating a community where leaders can exchange ideas and problem-solve, SNI helps systems work through complex issues and apply successful strategies from peers in their own settings.

Beyond these convenings, SNI creates practical resources and content to surface and share what is working across the field. These include lessons learned briefs, roadmaps, case studies, and articles drawn from member systems’ experiences.

**Position Summary and Primary Responsibilities**

The Program Coordinator plays an essential support role in planning and implementing SNI’s programs. Working closely with SNI and CAPH staff, the Coordinator will:

· Support the design and delivery of in-person and virtual learning events for health system leaders across SNI’s program areas (e.g., protecting Medicaid coverage and access, strengthening health equity, improving cost effectiveness and efficiency).

o Coordinate end-to-end event logistics, including developing and managing workplans, scheduling speaker prep calls, creating and administering pre-event surveys and post-event evaluations, and providing day-of support during events, among other duties.

o Work with the program team, particularly the team lead, to identify systems’ needs and develop program content and materials.

· Lead the Quality Leaders Awards ceremony and luncheon during CAPH/SNI’s Annual Conference.

o Prepare and disseminate the call for applications and organize submissions.

o Coordinate the judging process by helping to identify external judges, scheduling judging calls, and reviewing and scoring submissions with the judges’ panel.

o Oversee the awards ceremony and luncheon at the annual conference, including serving as the point of contact for awardees, preparing the SNI Board Chair to moderate, and managing all aspects of the day-of event, among other duties.

o Additionally, support the annual conference team in identifying and preparing conference speakers.

· Perform administrative duties, such as scheduling meetings, summarizing meeting notes, and printing and compiling meeting materials.

· Complete other duties and projects as needed.

**Required Knowledge and Experience**

· Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a health-related field, or commensurate experience.

· Minimum of 1 year of work experience, which may include internships and fellowships. Experience working in a health care setting and/or public agency a plus.

· Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects in a timely, organized manner with .

· Strong writing and editing skills. Adept at translating complex information into accessible language for a variety of audiences.

· Fluent in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Zoom. Preferred experience working with WordPress, Constant Contact, and/or online collaborative tools, such as Miro.

· Comfortable using AI tools to improve work quality and productivity while exercising independent thinking and ownership of final work.

· Excellent interpersonal and communication skills and ability to interact professionally and courteously with health system leadership, consultants, and peers.

· Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, learn on the fly, and work effectively in teams, as well as independently.

· Understanding of California’s health care landscape, particularly programs that serve Medicaid and uninsured patients, a plus.

**Work Environment**

CAPH/SNI operates in a hybrid work environment, with two required in-person days (Monday and Wednesday) at the office in Oakland, CA for those living 40 miles or less from the office; one required in-person day (Monday) for those living farther away. The remaining days are conducted remotely.

This role requires occasional in-state travel, including overnight travel for in-person convenings and the annual conference.

The starting salary range for this position is $65,000-$75,000. SNI offers an extremely competitive benefits package, as well as opportunities to attend professional conferences and participate in professional development trainings.

**Company Description**

KIOXIA America, Inc. (formerly Toshiba Memory America, Inc.) is the US-based subsidiary of KIOXIA Corporation, a leading worldwide supplier of flash memory and solid state drives (SSDs). From the invention of flash memory to today’s breakthrough BiCS FLASH™ 3D technology, KIOXIA continues to pioneer cutting-edge memory solutions and services that enrich people's lives and expand society's horizons. The company's innovative 3D flash memory technology, BiCS FLASH™, is shaping the future of storage in high-density applications, including advanced smartphones, PCs, SSDs, automotive and data centers.

 **Job Description**

KIOXIA America Inc. is seeking a highly skilled Partner Alliance/Technical Ecosystem Project Manager Specialist to develop and grow our SSD business in the SSD ecosystem development segment. This individual directly reports into the SSD BU and requires a unique blend of strategic negotiation, technical, and marketing skills. Not only will you coordinate internally with many cross-functional teams to reach critical business decisions on ecosystem and technical support strategy, but you will work with world-class ecosystem leaders directly in the industry. The ecosystem scope includes hardware companies such as CPUs, PCIe related peripherals, etc. and software companies such as Operating Systems, Storage Drivers, Virtualization Software, Software-Defined Storage (SDS) and so on.

Our ideal candidate will leverage their technical background to drive and manage ecosystem strategy at both a tactical and strategic level while working closely with customers, sales, product and business development managers, technical marketing and support, business ops, and other cross-functional teams. This is a complex job that requires exceptional attention to detail, multi-tasking capabilities, and the ability to follow through on initiatives with many internal teams.

**Key activities include:** Roadmap alignment with ecosystem partners, SSD sample planning, SSD validation testing and developing execution strategies on joint marketing and collaboration activities. This position provides an excellent opportunity to participate in growing the SSD ecosystem industry including NVMe, SDS, and other new emerging markets such as AI/ML, block-chain and autonomous driving.

**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary point of contact (PoC) for KIOXIA’s ecosystem strategy, leading the development, expansion, and management of strategic partnerships with leading global technology companies
* Build and execute a scalable ecosystem strategy that aligns with KIOXIA’s product roadmap, market priorities, and revenue objectives

* Develop and track KPIs for ecosystem success, including design wins, qualifications, joint solutions, and revenue influence
* Drive go-to-market alignment with partners, including joint messaging, solution briefs, and co-marketing initiatives

  
**Qualifications**  

* 7+ years of experience in ecosystem development, partnerships, or program management within the semiconductor, storage, or broader data center technology industry
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or related field
* MBA or Master’s degree preferred
* Proven ability to manage complex cross-functional programs and influence without authority across global teams
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging both technical and executive audiences

**Technical & Domain Expertise**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**POSITION TITLE:** **EVENT OPERATIONS** **COORDINATOR**

  

**On board experiential marketing**

OBE is a global marketing agency that brings brands to life through culture-shaping experiences. For more than 30 years, we've partnered with iconic brands — including Nike, the NFL, JPMorganChase, Meta, Sephora, Starbucks, and Converse — to build community, create cultural relevance, and drive measurable business impact. With offices in Los Angeles, New York, San Francisco, and London, we activate globally. OBE is also a founding member of The ADD Collective, extending our reach and resources while staying true to our core capabilities.

  

We've been recognized by Event Marketer as one of the best places to work in events — and we couldn't agree more.

  

The most important part of our business is our people. They are hardworking, imaginative, and make genuinely remarkable things happen. But behind every great activation is a human who deserves rest, connection, and a life outside of work. That's why we invest in recovery days, company offsites, happy hours, and the kind of friendly-but-competitive fitness challenges that bond teams for life.

  

We show up for each other — in open conversations that heal, inspire, and bring us closer. We want to hear about your lived experiences, your unconventional ideas, and the perspectives only you can bring. Being unapologetically yourself isn't just welcome here. It's part of the job.

  

**SUMMARY OF POSITION**

The Event Operations Coordinator is an integral part of the team responsible for successful management and production of our programs. Reporting to a senior Event Operations team member, this person performs various duties in the planning, development, activation and wrap up stages of both client programs and internal initiatives, both in office and onsite. The Event Operations Coordinator helps ensure the highest quality of service in the performance of the approved client statement of work so that all deliverables are executed with the utmost in professionalism, accountability, skill, and timeliness, thus successfully meeting program objectives at the highest level of client and agency satisfaction.

  

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**

* Prepare materials, documents, meeting agendas, and communications to client and internal teams.

* Support in tracking deliverables across Event Operations and cross functional teams (Production, Creative, Strategy, Tech), update key documents.

* Participate in weekly status meetings both internal and external as required, capturing detailed and accurate notes and action items.

* Ensure assigned areas of program responsibilities are successfully completed, delivered, and implemented during pre-production planning phase.

* Successfully manage areas of program execution onsite

* Participate in program tear down meetings, internal & client recap decks, and client KPI measurement reporting.

* Join or lead internal agency initiatives & task forces, offsite planning for department and agency needs.

  

**DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**

**Education / Experience**

* BA/BS in marketing, business administration, communications, or related field.

* 1 - 3 years' experience in marketing, promotions, and/or events, including on-site event experience. Experiential marketing agency experience preferred.

  

**Essential Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Strong interpersonal communication skills

* Ability to interact, internally, and with clients, at various organizational levels.

* Ability to connect with others authentically while equally honoring and respecting diverse perspectives.

* Ability to build trust and respect through communication and listening.

* Think creatively, with willingness to extend beyond the unexpected and consistently strive for innovation.

* Experience with brand management, ensuring brand integrity and quality is consistently maintained.

* Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and excellent organizational skills.

* Ability to navigate competing priorities and deadlines with ease.

* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and within teams.

* Pulse on social media trends and an understanding of how to utilize online methods to promote engagement.

* Must be able to work in a collaborative manner both internally and with clients.

* Ability to learn and navigate various office management platforms (inclusive of but not limited to Office 365, Keynote, Google Drive, Smartsheet, Slack, Zoom, etc)

  

**Other Qualities and Skills**

* Natural curiosity—the drive to always be learning and growing, professionally and personally.

* High energy and flexibility in working non-traditional hours as needed (some nights and weekends as deadlines dictate).

* Ability to lift up to 25 pounds and stay on your feet for extended periods of time.

* Willingness to work a hybrid schedule (at least 2 days in office) and travel up to 50% of the time.

  

**Compensation Range:** $70,304 - $77,652 annually. This is the pay range OBE believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the level of experience, relevant skills, professional certifications, market pay, and demand for the role. OBE reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. For this role, Benefits include medical/dental/vision insurance, employer-paid basic life and personal accident insurance. Also included: Annual Profit Sharing/Bonus Plan based on the company's performance and your individual performance, 401(k), Healthcare Flexible Spending Account, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, PTO, STD/LTD insurance benefits.

**Position Title:** **F****ield Marketing Operations Support (Embedded)**

  

**On board experiential marketing**

On Board Experiential (OBE) is an award-winning, full-service, experience-led agency that creates meaningful brand experiences worldwide. Recognized by Event Marketer as one of the best places to work in events, our clients include Nike, Meta, JPMorgan Chase, Sephora, Starbucks, and Converse, to name a few. We work out of our homes and physical offices in San Francisco, Los Angeles, NYC, and London, or wherever our adventures take us! That's why we believe in recovery days, happy hours, friendly but competitive fitness challenges, and OBE offsites.

We show up for each other — in open conversations that heal, inspire, and bring us closer. We want to hear about your lived experiences and unique perspectives. Being unapologetically yourself isn't just welcome here. It's part of the job.

OBE is seeking a Field Marketing Operations Support professional to join our team and be embedded within a client's Enterprise Field Marketing organization, supporting field programs across the Americas region. This role turns approved field marketing plans into coordinated execution — owning program management and marketing operations across the full event lifecycle — while working directly inside the client's systems, meetings, and planning rhythms as a trusted extension of their team.

While the role is operationally focused, the ideal candidate brings enough command of enterprise sales cycles, account-based marketing, and field marketing strategy to be more than an executor: someone who understands the business behind the events, sits close to sales, and proactively flags risks and recommends changes rather than simply reporting status.

**Campaign & Lead Operations**

* Perform quality checks to ensure accurate campaign and lead tracking.

**Reporting & Follow-Up**

* Track follow-up actions and maintain visibility into outstanding items for the client's team.

**Strategic Fluency & Account Support**

* Sit in on sales calls and leadership meetings as needed to understand full account context, not just the events being supported.

**summary of position**

* Experience working within enterprise marketing and sales tech stacks (e.g., Salesforce/SFDC, marketing automation platforms, event registration tools).

* BA/BS in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field; relevant work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

**Essential Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Familiarity with Salesforce (SFDC) campaign setup, lead management, and marketing operations workflows.

* Working understanding of account-based marketing (ABM) strategy and execution.

* Comfort operating inside a client's systems, tools, and meeting cadences as an embedded team member.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trust with sales, marketing, and executive stakeholders.

* Analytical mindset; able to synthesize event and program performance data into clear, actionable recommendations.

**Other Qualities and Skills**

* Comfortable embedding within a client's team and adapting to their systems, culture, and cadence.

* High energy and flexibility to support event timelines, which may include non-traditional hours.

**About Refold AI**

Enterprise integrations are still built by hand, one customer at a time, by a human supply chain of consultants. We think that's the last big software category that hasn't been automated — and we're automating it.

Refold is the AI integration delivery layer. Our agents build, test, deploy, and maintain integration workflows inside our customers' own products, white-labeled, up to 90% faster. Trained on millions of real-world contexts across SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, and Salesforce, we turn integration work that used to take quarters into days — and then keep it running, because the agents detect failures and repair mappings themselves.

**Traction:** 30+ paying enterprise customers, 1,500+ active users, 10M+ API calls processed daily, seven-figure ARR. Customers include Incorta, Kantata, Coupa, Naehas, OvationCXM, and Zycus. The results are the pitch: Kantata ships integrations 75% faster with 8x delivery capacity; Incorta cut time-to-go-live by 70% and recovered 8,000+ engineering hours; Naehas went from 3–5-month builds to 90% faster delivery.

Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia and Abhishek Kumar, who have been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30. We've raised $6.5M led by Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber) and Tidal Ventures, with Better Capital, Ahead VC, Karman Ventures, Z21 Ventures, and Titan Ventures participating.

We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one. Our buyers don't come from paid ads — they come from the room. Practice leaders, integration architects, and product executives who trust each other more than they trust a vendor. This seat owns that room.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Own the event calendar:** Plan, run, and measure our presence at PMA, SAP Connect, TSIA, Ai4, and the industry moments where our buyers actually gather. Speaking slots, booths, side events, and the follow-up that turns a conversation into a meeting
* **Run the dinner series:** Executive networking dinners in target metros are one of our best pipeline sources. Own the guest list, the format, the venue, and the outcome — and scale it beyond one city
* **Produce** ***Unfolded*****:** Our podcast is a ten-minute rapid-fire format built to open doors with mid-funnel accounts. Own guest sourcing, booking, production, and the recap content that gives each episode a second life

* **Carry a pipeline number:** Field marketing here is measured in meetings booked, opportunities sourced, and pipeline influenced. Badge scans are not the metric

**Required Skills & Abilities**

* **Field marketing track record:** 5–8 years in community, field, or event marketing at B2B SaaS, with meaningful time at a Series A or B company where you owned the calendar rather than supported it
* **You've run the room:** Conferences, executive dinners, roadshows, and side events — you've done the venue calls, the guest list triage, the run-of-show, and the awkward moment when a speaker cancels at 6 pm

**About the Company:**

GreenWaste has been an industry leader in recycling and waste diversion for 40 years and is on a growth trajectory after private equity investment in 2021. Our business was founded on principles of environmental sustainability, and innovation is a cornerstone of our ongoing operations and growth strategy. GreenWaste specializes in all aspects of material collection, processing, and sales, tailoring our service offerings to the unique needs of our customers and communities, and helping to shape the evolution of the solid waste and recycling industry. We work directly with 20+ municipalities and 50+ jurisdictions, operate highly regulated facilities in 10+ locations, and have 1,000+ employees.

**Position** **Summary:**

The Environmental Outreach Coordinator delivers outreach and education across assigned jurisdictions to support community engagement, regulatory compliance, and waste-diversion goals. Up to sixty percent of the role is spent in the field, conducting waste audits by inspecting residential carts and commercial waste and recycling containers to assess sorting practices, identify contamination, and support diversion efforts. The Coordinator also educates residents and businesses on proper waste sorting and diversion practices, participates in community events, and delivers presentations to schools, community groups, and other audiences. Assignments may span multiple jurisdictions based on contract and operational requirements.

Waste Audits & Field Assessments

* Conduct in-person field audits by inspecting residential carts and commercial and multi-family waste, recycling, and organics containers to assess sorting practices, contamination, and compliance.
* Perform on-site assessments to identify contamination, service issues, and opportunities to improve waste diversion and proper sorting.
* Document and submit audit findings in accordance with contract and program requirements.

Program Implementation

* Carry out outreach and education activities required under applicable contract service agreements.
* Support implementation of waste reduction, reuse, recycling, and organics programs.
* Complete required outreach, education, tracking, and follow-up activities in accordance with program and contract requirements.

Customer Education & Outreach

* Provide on-site education and training to residents, businesses, and other customers regarding proper sorting, contamination reduction, waste diversion, and program requirements
* Deliver educational presentations to schools, community groups, businesses, and civic organizations.

Community Events & Engagement

* Coordinate logistics, materials, and staffing for community outreach events.
* Represent GreenWaste at community events, workshops, and public meetings.
* Develop interactive activities and distribute educational materials.

Outreach Logistics & Coordination

* Organize materials, transportation, and scheduling for field and outreach activities.

Collateral & Communications

* Develop flyers, signage, newsletters, and other outreach materials in collaboration with the communications team.

Reporting & Data Collection

* Ability and willingness to conduct field inspections of residential carts and commercial waste, recycling, and organics containers to assess contents, identify contamination, and evaluate proper sorting.

* Ability to work independently in the field and collaboratively with internal teams, municipal partners, customers, and community stakeholders.

* Ability to lift and carry materials weighing up to 20 pounds.

* Foster a culture of continuous learning, team collaboration, high accountability, and customer-centricity.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Demonstrated expertise in sales and coaching methodologies, and developing individual contributor skillsets.
* Strong leadership agility with experience operating in high-growth, fast-paced environments, and navigating complex organizational structures.
* Proven success building and maintaining long term commercial relationships, including interfacing directly with executive buyers.

* High integrity; enthusiastic about building a great company for the long term

jobs.title: Sales Representative (bilingual Mandarin & English)
jobs.description:
**About us:**

We are a coffee roastery and bakery located within walking distance of Santa Clara University. We pride ourselves on sourcing the finest beans, fostering a welcoming atmosphere, and delivering top-notch customer service. As we continue to grow, we are seeking a passionate and skilled Sales Representative to join our team

**Position:** Bilingual Sales Associate / Sales & Business Development Representative

**Pay: $18.70/hour Base Pay + $10/hour Position Allowance + 1%–5% Sales Commission**  
**Work Location:** 1002 Monroe Street, Santa Clara, CA 95050  
**Schedule:** Part-time / Full-time, up to 40 hours per week

**Overview:**

We are looking for a motivated and proactive person who can help WhatCoffee develop new sales and business opportunities.

The position starts at **$18.70/hour**. Employees will be evaluated **every two weeks** based on their abilities, work performance, sales activity, communication, customer development, follow-up, and overall suitability for the Sales & Business Development position.

If the employee demonstrates the ability and is suitable for the Sales & Business Development position, they may be assigned to that position and receive an additional **$10/hour position allowance**, plus **1%–5% commission on qualifying sales**.

If the employee does not demonstrate the necessary ability or is not suitable for the Sales & Business Development position, the company may consider the employee for another available position with the applicable base pay.

**Sales & Business Development Responsibilities**

The employee will be responsible for actively finding and developing new customers and sales opportunities, including:

* Developing wholesale accounts.
* Contacting supermarkets, grocery stores, markets, hotels, restaurants, cafés, offices, and companies.
* Contacting event organizers, festivals, markets, and other organizations.
* Finding new businesses and sales channels for WhatCoffee products.
* Making phone calls, sending emails, visiting potential customers, and following up on leads.
* Building and maintaining business relationships.
* Developing catering and corporate sales opportunities.
* Preparing and following up on quotes, orders, and sales inquiries.
* Tracking leads, customer contacts, and sales activity.
* Meeting sales targets and developing new business.

The employee is expected to be **proactive and able to find new customers**, rather than waiting for customers to contact the company.

**Performance Review**

Performance will be reviewed **every two weeks**.

Sales targets will be used as performance benchmarks:

* **Month 1: $5,000**
* **Month 2: $10,000**
* **Month 3: $15,000**
* **After Month 3: $20,000/month**

**Sales numbers are only one part of the evaluation. The employee's ability, initiative, communication, customer development, follow-up, reliability, and overall performance are more important in determining whether the employee is suitable for the Sales & Business Development position.**

Based on the performance review, the company may continue the employee in the Sales & Business Development position with the **$10/hour position allowance**, continue evaluating the employee, or consider the employee for another position based on business needs and qualifications.

**Compensation**

**Base Position**

* $18.70/hour

**Sales & Business Development Position**

* $18.70/hour base pay
* Additional **$10/hour position allowance**
* **1%–5% commission on qualifying sales**

**Qualifications**

* **Must be bilingual in English and Mandarin**
* Sales or business development experience preferred.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable making calls, sending emails, and contacting new businesses.
* Self-motivated and proactive.
* Strong follow-up and organizational skills.
* Able to work independently.
* Customer service or wholesale sales experience is a plus.
* Food, bakery, restaurant, hotel, supermarket, or retail sales experience is a plus.
* English required.
* Driver's license preferred.

**Benefits**

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Opportunity to earn position allowance and sales commission

Pay: $18.70 - $28.70 per hour

Experience:

* Sales: 2 years (Preferred)

Language:

* Mandarin (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* driver's license (Preferred)

Willingness to travel:

* 25% (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

Our West Bay branch, located in East Palo Alto, CA, is seeking an **Entry-Level Business Development Representative** to join our team. This position is ideal for individuals looking to start a career in sales and business development.

The primary focus of this role is **canvassing and prospecting for new business**. You will spend the majority of your time in the field identifying potential customers, visiting job sites and businesses, and introducing our services through **in-person, off-site sales activities**. This role involves consistent cold outreach and face-to-face engagement to generate new leads and sales opportunities.

This opportunity provides:

$700 weekly base salary plus weekly performance based bonus for an average salary range between $50,300-$67,000.

Competitive benefits package

Company matching 401K (up to 3% additional match)

Mileage reimbursement

Founded in 1935, Roto-Rooter is North America's largest plumbing, drain cleaning, and water cleanup services provider. Roto-Rooter operates businesses in over 100 company-owned branches, independent contractor territories, and approximately 400 independent franchise operations, serving approximately 90% of the U.S. population and parts of Canada.

Responsibilities:

What you will be doing:

  

* Conduct in‑person visits with existing and prospective commercial customers providing trustworthy service.
* Establish, strengthen, and maintain customer relationships through regular field visits, on‑site consultations, and follow‑up meetings.

* Promote and sell preventative maintenance programs and priority care service plans to both new and existing customers.
* Utilize the Salesforce CRM platform to document customer visits, track relationship value, record sales activities, and manage the sales pipeline.
* Prepare and deliver on‑site presentations, service recommendations, and customized proposals.
* Attend industry events, trade shows, and networking functions to generate leads and represent the company.
* Collaborate with internal operations teams to ensure successful delivery of sold services.

Regular travel to customer and prospect locations, trade events, and other sites away from the company’s office is required. This is a hands-on, field-based position that offers an opportunity to build foundational sales skills, gain real-world experience, and grow within a sales organization.

* Commercial sales experience with proven year-over-year record for successful development and growth of a territory preferred.
* Acceptable background check per company standards
* Extensive driving and travel to customer locations within the assigned territory in a timely and professional manner.
* Administrative tasks that support field sales activities.
* Highschool diploma or equivalent

* Medical insurance with a Prescription Drug Card
* Accident and Critical Illness Insurance
* Dental Insurance

* Paid Training

* Matching 401K Retirement Savings Plan
* Tuition Reimbursement
