jobs.description:
American Window Film is seeking a high-performing Commercial Sales Representative to drive revenue growth within an assigned metro territory. This is a strategic outside sales role focused on delivering exceptional customer service to generate repeat business, winning large commercial projects, and expanding and developing a strong commercial client base.

The ideal candidate understands the construction sales cycle, can read architectural plans, and is comfortable working with General Contractors, Glass Companies, Property Managers, and Facilities professionals.

**Job Responsibilities**

Territory & Business Development

* Develop and execute a territory sales plan to achieve revenue and margin targets
* Prospect and cultivate new commercial relationships within the assigned metro area
* Build strategic relationships with General Contractors, Glass & Glazing Companies, Commercial Property Management Firms, Facilities Management Professionals, and Building Owners & Developers
* Actively network within the local construction and commercial real estate community

Project & Sales Process Management

* Manage a proactive sales process from prospecting to close and project turnover
* Conduct site visits, take field measurements, and collaborate with estimating
* Review architectural plans and specifications as needed
* Develop and present detailed proposals tailored to client needs
* Negotiate pricing and scope while protecting company margin standards
* Close large-scale commercial projects

Customer Experience & Account Management

* Provide a high level of service to build long-term repeat relationships
* Maintain consistent communication throughout estimating, scheduling, and installation
* Proactively resolve issues to ensure customer satisfaction
* Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing accounts

Performance & Reporting

* Maintain accurate CRM activity and pipeline management
* Track and report key metrics: $ Installed Revenue, $ Estimated / Pipeline Volume, Close Ratio vs. Targets, Margin Performance
* Participate in weekly sales meetings and forecasting reviews

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of outside sales experience
* Proven ability to win and manage large commercial projects
* Experience working within the construction or commercial building industry
* Strong relationship-building and networking skills
* Self-motivated with strong territory management discipline
* Must have a valid Driver’s License and a clean Driver’s Record to drive company vehicle

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with window film, glazing, glass, or related building envelope products
* Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings and specifications
* Experience selling to General Contractors or Property Management firms
* CRM proficiency

**Core Competencies**

* Strategic Prospecting
* Relationship-Driven Selling
* Consultative Sales Approach
* Project Management Mindset
* Financial & Margin Awareness
* Strong Communication & Negotiation Skills
* High Accountability to Metrics

**Benefits & Perks**

* Competitive monthly commission program
* Flexible Schedule: Work day is spent on the road and/or in office
* Paid Time Off plan for full time employees
* Medical, Dental, Vision, and more \*For eligible employees
* 401(k): American Window Film will match 3% of what you contribute

American Window Film Perks:

* Family & Friends Day - take an extra day off and get $300 to spend time with family and friends.
* People Helping People - take an extra day off to help someone out or contribute to a worthy cause
* Fitness, Health and Wellness allowance - get $250 towards any health and wellness activity
* We not me time - get $300 when you spend time with a co-worker outside of work
* perks subject to terms and conditions and may change at any time

PAY RANGE:

* Base Salary: $80,000/yr + 4% monthly commission
* OTE: $140,000-$160,000+/yr

**Our Core Values**

* Create Loyal fans - We create an environment that people love
* Authenticity Matters - Trust is built one job at a time
* Be Excellent Together - We support our teammates
* We Embrace Change - How we got here today is not how we will get there tomorrow

**Physical Demands**

* Ability to lift up to 50 lbs
* Ability to drive a company work vehicle
* Must have a valid Driver’s License

Our customers include the largest semiconductor chip and OEM tool manufacturers in the industry. We stay at the forefront of our industry through innovation, technical proficiency, and our amazing employees. Our industry is in the midst of unprecedented growth and Pentagon is seeking outstanding candidates to join our team!

**Job Summary**

The Production Coordinator provides cross-functional support to multiple departments to ensure operational objectives and customer requirements are met efficiently and effectively. This role is responsible for supporting safety initiatives, employee training, qualification projects, engineering data entry, and daily production activities. The position also provides logistics support, including local customer pickups and deliveries, and may require travel to remote locations for technical and operational systems training.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support and promote a culture of safety by ensuring compliance with company safety policies, procedures, and protocols. Assist in maintaining equipment, machinery, and tools in safe working condition.
* Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders through both written and verbal communication to support operational objectives.
* Create and maintain internal job numbers, production schedules, and work orders while coordinating activities across departments to ensure projects are completed on time and within quality standards.
* Assist in onboarding and training new employees on departmental procedures, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and On-the-Job Training (OJT) requirements.
* Partner closely with Production, Quality, and Engineering teams to support qualification projects, iCOA activities, and process validation efforts, ensuring compliance with safety and quality requirements.
* Maintain accurate records and documentation within FileMaker and JIRA systems, including process specifications, DMR databases, process deviation records, and safety-related reports.
* Provide logistics support through customer service, local pickups, deliveries, and coordination of transportation activities as needed.
* Support onsite inspections and inventory audits at external fulfillment and warehouse service providers.
* Monitor production processes and product flow to ensure adherence to established process specifications, quality standards, and delivery commitments.
* Assist with continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing safety, quality, productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned by the Director of Operations or Production Manager.

* Demonstrated commitment to safety and the ability to consistently apply safe work practices in all job duties and responsibilities.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain attention to detail.

* Strong problem-solving and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across departments.

jobs.description:
**Project Coordinator, Safety Projects and Programs, RIS**
==========================================================

* DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION

Posted on

10/29/2026

* Full-time

Location

MANHATTAN

* No exam required

Department

Salary range: $62,868.00 – $97,593.00

Save

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Transportation Planning and Management Division (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility and markings, and ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  
  
Research, Implementation, and Safety unit (RIS) is a multi-disciplinary team dedicated to making the streets of New York City safer for all users as part of Vision Zero, a citywide policy striving to eliminate serious injuries and fatalities from traffic crashes. RIS uses a data-driven approach to design and implement street safety redesign projects, administer safety programs, promote senior and youth safety, manage crash data and data applications, conduct large-scale safety research projects, and lead agency action plans related to safety and Vision Zero programs/policy.
  
  
RIS’ Safety Projects and Programs team is seeking candidates for a Project Coordinator position. The candidate will be responsible for planning, developing, designing, conducting outreach, and implementing Street Improvement Projects to improve safety for pedestrians, motor vehicles, bicyclists, transit riders, and motorcyclists, with a focus on the goals of the Streets Plan and Vision Zero. The position will focus on incorporating proven safety treatments to improve safety for all users as part of DOT’s commitment to Vision Zero and improving the safety, reliability, and accessibility of transit corridors.
  
  
Key tasks for this position include performing research and crash analysis to identify high crash locations, scoping and designing safety improvement projects for high crash locations, analyzing traffic data, preparing reports/graphics and maps, conducting field work including on-site evaluations and field meetings, coordinating project implementation, and providing technical assistance to senior staff. The selected candidates will also be required to participate in community outreach, including developing outreach plans and materials meetings with public officials, Community Boards, and inter- and intra-agency stakeholders. The ideal candidate should be detail-oriented, a capable team player, and possess excellent communication skills. This is an opportunity to work with a team dedicated to improving safety, accessibility, and mobility throughout New York City.
  
  
COMMUNITY COORDINATOR - 56058

  
  

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

  
  

1. A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties described above; or
  
2. High school graduation or equivalent and six years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties as described above; or
  
3. Education and/or experience which is equivalent to "1" or "2" above. However, all candidates must have at least one year of experience as described in "1" above.

  
  

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

  
The preferred candidate will be proficient in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Adobe Creative Suite. The preferred candidate will have experience in AutoCAD, and GIS. Traffic engineering software is a plus. Knowledge of traffic calming, urban design, pedestrian-oriented design, complete streets, and traffic engineering. Excellent writing, editing, oral presentation, and community outreach skills preferred. Preference will be given to candidate who possess a driver's license valid in the state of New York with no restrictions. This license must be maintained throughout the duration of employment in this position.
  

**Public Service Loan Forgiveness**
-----------------------------------

  
As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal loan forgiveness programs and state repayment assistance programs. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website at https://studentaid.gov/pslf/.
  

**Residency Requirement**
-------------------------

  
New York City residency is generally required within 90 days of appointment. However, City Employees in certain titles who have worked for the City for 2 continuous years may also be eligible to reside in Nassau, Suffolk, Putnam, Westchester, Rockland, or Orange County. To determine if the residency requirement applies to you, please discuss with the agency representative at the time of interview.
  

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

  
  

The City of New York is an inclusive equal opportunity employer committed to recruiting and retaining a diverse workforce and providing a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment based upon any legally protected status or protected characteristic, including but not limited to an individual's sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity, or pregnancy.

jobs.description:
**About the Alpha Engine Department**

The Alpha Engine is responsible for Pure Alpha, Bridgewater’s flagship alpha strategy launched in 1991. Our aim in Pure Alpha is to generate high and consistent returns, uncorrelated to markets and other managers over time. We pursue this by systematically deploying our fundamental understanding of markets and economies to trade long, short, and relative value across roughly 200 liquid public markets.

**About Your Role**

The Investor Talent team partners with investors across Bridgewater’s investment departments on how the firm identifies, assesses, develops, and compensates its investors, at a time of significant change for the firm. The team is building as it goes, which leaves real room to shape how things run.

The Program Coordinator role is an execution-focused role at the center of how the Investor Talent team runs. You’ll work directly with the team's manager, leads, and senior investors, bringing tight execution and project management skills to translate priorities into practical plans and drive investor programs from planning through delivery. Your book of work will shift with the calendar, with management of the team's operations and programs taking up the majority of your time during peak periods.

We are a nimble, hands-on team where every member contributes to the operational work through to the outcomes that make our programs successful (e.g., attending the events that you help shape and plan). We’re looking for someone who takes pride in getting the details right, follows through reliably, and is equally willing to coordinate calendars, pull ongoing metrics, or improve and own a process. It’s a fast-moving environment with a lot to learn, so curiosity and adaptability will go a long way. Over time, the right person will take on broader project management ownership, improve how our programs run, and manage increasingly complex workstreams.

You will drive the following responsibilities:

* **Primary partner in running a tight talent ecosystem:** Partner with the team’s manager and leads to understand the broad mission of investor talent, and own coordination at the goal level rather than the task level. In practice, this means owning the calendar, meeting logistics, agendas, and program sessions and materials, and anticipating needs before you’re asked.
* **Owner of the team’s management machines:** Build, run, and continuously improve the recurring processes that keep the team operating, including review cycles, security, and operations. Keep meetings, follow-ups, and commitments on track across these processes. Own knowledge management across SharePoint, Confluence, and distribution lists, with room to shape how it works and evolves.
* **Project manager for key programs:** Own day-to-day execution of the summer internship and investor class, from scheduling and communications to materials and events. Translate priorities into clear plans with timelines, owners, and dependencies, and adapt as needs change. Anticipate risks, resolve bottlenecks, and hold stakeholders accountable to their commitments, escalating with sound judgment when needed. Track engagement metrics to assess how well each program is working.
* **Key driver of technology and AI to raise team productivity:** Use technology and AI to improve how the team works, from automating coordination and communications to streamlining reviews and programs. Proactively look for ways to run things better, and connect the dots across workstreams so improvements spread.

The anticipated onsite requirement for this role is four days per week, primarily at our New York City campus.

**Minimum Qualifications**

You have a passion for running and improving processes and take pride in making others’ worlds run smoothly. You are proactive and comfortable holding others accountable directly and respectfully, including more senior colleagues.

* 2+ years of experience in coordination, project management, business operations, or a similar role, in a fast-paced, stakeholder-facing environment
* Strong attention to detail and operational discipline, with the ability to prioritize across multiple concurrent workstreams and adapt to ambiguity
* Excellent written and verbal communication with a range of stakeholders
* Ability to work flexible hours as needed, e.g., some evenings or onsite additional days for key program events

**About Bridgewater**

Bridgewater Associates is a global macro investment firm, founded in 1975, whose mission is to develop a fundamental, cause-and-effect understanding of how markets and economies work—and translate that understanding into insights, returns, and solutions that help the world’s leading institutional investors solve their most important investment challenges.

Over five decades, we have codified our fundamental understanding into a systematic investment process—integrating human judgment with machine intelligence with the goal of applying our thinking consistently, testing it against reality, and continuously improving decision-making over time. We believe this has created a unique platform for applying AI within our process, positioning us at the frontier of integrating technology with investment decision-making.

In financial markets—where reality is constantly evolving and outcomes are uncertain—sustained excellence requires continuous learning and improvement. Our culture—anchored in radical truth and transparency—helps us learn faster.

Find more information about Bridgewater on our website.

**Our Culture**

Bridgewater’s culture is anchored in the pursuit of excellence—tied directly to our mission. In financial markets, where the base case is failure and reality is constantly evolving, winning requires continuous learning and improvement. Truth is our most essential tool for improvement, and transparency helps us get closer to truth because it places many eyes on our decisions, problems, and mistakes. Keel Infrastructure is a publicly traded energy and digital infrastructure company that develops and owns data centers and power assets across North America.

At Keel, you're not just joining a company, you're helping build the infrastructure behind the future of compute.

  

**Why Keel**

We're at the intersection of energy and technology, two industries transforming in real time.

The work is complex. The pace is fast. The impact is real.

You'll be part of a team that values:

* **Ownership**— we take responsibility and follow through
* **Collaboration**— we work across teams, functions, and borders
* **Curiosity**— we ask questions and keep learning
* **Endurance**— we build for the long term

  

**What It Feels Like to Work Here**

* Fast-moving, high-growth, and hands-on
* Smart, driven people solving real challenges together
* Work that directly supports AI and next-generation infrastructure
* Room to grow, stretch, and take on more

  

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary, bonus and equity opportunities
* Comprehensive health and wellness benefits
* Retirement savings with company contribution
* Employee referral program

  

We are currently looking for a **Program Coordinator** to join our team

  

**Role Summary**

Keel Infrastructure is seeking a Program Coordinator in Program Delivery to manage the team's internal process and maintain the source of truth for program governance and strategy. Reporting to the VP, Data Center Program Delivery, this role keeps documentation and process organized across the design and construction of HPC data center facilities, so each group has what it needs to project success.

This is an entry-level / early-career role. The Program Coordinator works closely with the Customer Success Manager, Pre-Construction Director, Leasing and Corp Dev, Design, Project Controls, Procurement, Construction, and Operations.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Governance and Strategy:** Maintain and keep organized company documentation, procedures, and process to support program-level planning and execution across engineering, controls, and construction.
* **Program Health:** Schedule and run the internal program meeting cadence; prepare agendas, capture minutes, track actions to closure, and flag blockers early.
* **Process Coordination:** Coordinate the team's process across groups; track that both handoffs (tenant requirements and site) are complete and received, and keep each handoff documented and on track. Identify routine tasks that can be standardized or automated, and propose improvements using AI.
* **Trackers:** Maintain program trackers, including action items, decisions, risks, the change log, design review comments, and open items; track milestone adherence and flag early-warning deviations to the managers.
* **Reporting Inputs:** Compile weekly and monthly status inputs from the team and partners; prepare drafts of internal reports and tenant reports for the Customer Success Manager and VP of Data Center Program Delivery.
* **Documentation:** Maintain organized program documentation and folder structure so the current version of any key document is easy to find. Manage commissioning and turnover documentation for the Customer Success Manager and the VP of Data Center Program Delivery.
* **Portfolio Dashboards and KPIs:** Build and maintain portfolio-level dashboards and KPI reporting (cost, schedule, risk, capital efficiency) for the VP to present; implement integrated reporting tools and workflows (such as Procore, P6, Smartsheet, Power BI, SharePoint) with Project Controls.

**Qualifications**

jobs.description:
**LOCATION**

DOROT is headquartered on the Upper West Side of Manhattan, and staff works on a hybrid schedule. The Program Coordinator of Learning, Culture & Community oversees the implementation of many in-person programs and is expected to work in the office a minimum of 3 days per week.

  

**ABOUT DOROT**

Founded in 1976, DOROT (“generations” in Hebrew) facilitates a dynamic partnership between older adults, volunteers, and professionals through programs designed to combat social isolation and loneliness and bring the generations together. DOROT is dedicated to enhancing the lives of older adults to help them live more independently as valued community members. Compassion and commitment to excellence are hallmarks of DOROT’s programs and staff. The agency is a recognized innovative leader in mobilizing volunteers and infusing social work into its service delivery model. Our programs are conducted onsite, in the home, remotely and in the community.

**ABOUT THE** **LEARNING, CULTURE & COMMUNITY DEPARTMENT**

DOROT believes that community is not something people simply belong to – it is something people build together, one gathering at a time. The Learning, Culture & Community team annually engages over 4,500 adults aged 60 to 100+ by developing classes, workshops, cultural events, social gatherings, and other programs that build relationships and community. Offered in person, online via Zoom, and over the telephone, our peer group programs promote lifelong learning, health and wellness, creative expression, and meaningful social connection.

**ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY**

Reporting the Manager of Learning, Culture & Community, the Program Coordinator, Learning, Culture & Community will serve as a proactive, creative, and collaborative member of the Learning, Culture & Community team, performing a combination of programmatic, educational and administrative responsibilities. The Coordinator will contribute to the achievement of program and constituent goals through the development and implementation of in-person and virtual programs that bring people together for conversation, celebration, recreation, and shared cultural experiences. The successful candidate will bring warmth, initiative, and genuine curiosity in older adults and their stories, recognizing participants as contributors to a vibrant community.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Serve as a proactive and collaborative member of the Learning, Culture & Community team, contributing to the achievement of program and constituent goals.
* Design, plan, and execute group program experiences that encourage interaction and participation, strengthen connections among participants, and foster an enduring sense of belonging. This includes structured and facilitated programs as well as informal opportunities for connection in the following areas:
  + Community-building programs, including facilitated discussion groups, interactive group experiences, and gatherings that cultivate meaningful relationships over time.
  + Art and cultural programming, including performances, educational experiences, and institutional partnerships that inspire creativity, exploration, and lifelong learning.
  + Gatherings around national and Jewish holidays, seasonal transitions, and other meaningful occasions that make room for celebration, memory, reflection, and companionship.
* Manage all aspects of program coordination, from concept through implementation and follow-up, including presenter and participation communication, room and technology needs, registration oversight and attendance tracking, and production of program specific materials.

* Cultivate**,** maintain, and deepen relationships with a wide array of facilitators, artists, performers, volunteers, and cultural and community organizations; coach and support them in developing programs and gatherings that invite opportunities for connection.
* Strengthen constituent relationships and engagement by gathering feedback, identifying needs and interests, and translating them into opportunities for connection within the broader DOROT community.

* Collaborate with other DOROT departments to support constituent needs and strengthen program planning, including conferring with Supportive Services staff, preparing program data and materials for fundraising proposals and reports, and contributing to targeted marketing and outreach strategies.
* Train, mentor, and oversee office volunteers and interns to ensure best practices and positive experiences for them and participants.
* Collect and enter participation data, constituent interactions, and partner relationships using DOROT’s online database (Salesforce); contribute to the review of statistics for internal reports and analysis of trends.
* Complete other duties as assigned.

  

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Minimum of 4 years of professional experience in community engagement, social services, nonprofit programming, arts and culture, education, health and wellness programming, or a similar field
* Experience in planning, coordinating, or facilitating programs and events for adults required; background in arts and culture, community building, or social programming preferred
* Successful track record of designing inclusive and engaging experiences that foster participation, trust, and belonging amongst participants
* Demonstrated success building and maintaining relationships with facilitators, artists, and partners
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage warmly, professionally, and effectively with people of all ages, including older adults, colleagues, volunteers, presenters, and community partners
* Outstanding organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines
* Self-starter who is highly proactive, detail-oriented, flexible, and able to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
* Comfort with public speaking and participant

Established in 2011, Express Kafeh brings premium coffee experiences to events across the United States and internationally. Our work combines hospitality, equipment, logistics, and teamwork—and every successful event depends on getting the details right.

You will take ownership of assigned events from preparation and equipment readiness through setup, service, breakdown, and final reporting. You must be equally comfortable speaking with a client, directing baristas, checking inventory, loading equipment, and stepping in when something needs fixing.

**This position involves frequent travel, physical work, early mornings, evenings, weekends, and overnight stays.**

* Review event orders, service requirements, schedules, staffing plans, venue instructions, and client expectations.
* Coordinate with our Director of Operations, account managers, warehouse team, and travel coordinator.
* Verify that equipment, supplies, branding, and backup materials are complete, tested, and ready.
* Lead in staging, packing, loading, and inventory checks.
* Confirm access, loading arrangements, power requirements, setup timing, and other essential venue details.
* Identify missing information or potential problems early and follow through until resolved.

* Direct in unloading, station setup, equipment testing, and final presentation.
* Brief baristas and support staff on assignments, service standards, schedules, and expectations.

* Supervise attendance, appearance, breaks, replenishment, and service performance.

jobs.description:
About PAL

The Police Athletic League (PAL) of New York City is an independent youth development nonprofit organization and has been a vibrant and vital institution, serving as an effective, critical bridge between police and communities across all five boroughs of the City since 1914. PAL operates diverse programs for children as young as 2 years old to young adults. Programs include Head Start, after-school programs and summer day camps for elementary, middle and high school youth, and summer Playstreets. PAL also runs evening teen centers and college readiness programs, youth employment, and juvenile justice programs. Staying true to PAL’s roots, a cornerstone of our youth development strategy includes offering competitive and recreational sports for children of all ages. At PAL, we’re devoted to empowering communities and building the best places to work, and that goes for our own teams too.

Position Summary

The HEAF Outreach Coordinator supports the daily operations of PAL's HEAF program at the Harlem Center, serving middle and high school students in grades 6–12. Responsibilities include coordinating program activities, maintaining student records and attendance, managing schedules, supporting events, and communicating with students and families.

The position also supports student recruitment, family engagement, and community outreach while helping connect students to academic enrichment, college access, career exploration, and leadership opportunities. Working under the direction of the HEAF Program Director, the Outreach Coordinator helps ensure students and families remain informed, engaged, and connected to program resources.

Commitment & Compensation

* Schedule: 10 hours per week
* Salary: $30 per hour

Major Duties & Responsibilities

* Program Support: Assist with the coordination of daily program activities, schedules, student rosters, attendance, and general program needs.
* Student and Family Communication: Communicate with students and families regarding program schedules, activities, events, attendance, and important updates. Assist with follow-up when students are absent.
* Outreach and Recruitment: Assist with student recruitment, enrollment, and outreach to local schools, families, and community organizations to promote program participation.
* Events and Activities: Help organize workshops, college tours, family activities, and special events, including coordinating sign-ups and collecting required permission forms.
* Administrative Support: Maintain attendance records and student documentation, assist with routine administrative tasks, and provide program updates to the HEAF Program Director.
* Other duties as assigned.

What You Bring:

* High school diploma required. Associate’s degree or higher in a relevant human services field preferred.
* 1-2 years of community outreach, youth development or other relevant experience required.
* Demonstrated skills and competency in culturally relevant approaches and youth development.
* Non-judgmental approach and ability to empathize with others.
* Demonstrated experience establishing and maintaining community partnerships.
* Experience working in an ethnically, culturally and racially diverse environment.
* Ability to collaborate as part of a team.
* Leadership skills in conflict intervention, negotiation, decision-making, and delegation.
* Dynamic energy, able to multi-task and negotiate multiple requests.
* Committed to working toward positive community change.
* Strong communication skills, both oral and written. Ability to speak effectively and persuasively to staff, members, parents, groups, and community residents.
* Ability to work evenings, early mornings and/or weekend hours as may be required periodically.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications

Location: Harlem Center – 441 Manhattan Avenue, New York, NY

jobs.description:
**About Bureau:**

Bureau is a founder-led global company built around a simple belief: better spaces make better work.

Today, we make soundproof office booths that help people focus, meet and think. But our ambition is much bigger than what we sell. We want to shape how people do their best work, and build a company that can make a meaningful dent in the way work feels.

We’re a small, fast-moving team with a lot still to build. That means real ownership, room for good ideas and the chance to have an outsized impact.

**At Bureau, our people are what make us different:**

At the heart of our business is a global team of **passionate, caring, highly accountable and entrepreneurial people** who are empowered to make an impact. We bring our true selves, unique talents and personalities to work every day — and we believe that’s what makes our culture stronger.

We’re first and foremost a **sales-driven organization, powered by technology and design**, with a big ambition: to shape how people do their best work. Through our best-in-class modular workspaces and booths, we’re helping businesses create better places to work — with products that ship around the world.

Our team is global, connected and growing. We operate from our main hubs across **Australia, Canada (Vancouver and Toronto), the US (New York and Dallas), and UK/Europe** and are supported by talented teams across the **Philippines,** **Argentina, Mexico, Colorado** and growing. We’re continuing to expand, with new hubs planned in **Los Angeles and San Francisco**.

**Our Core Values:**

* **We are intrinsically motivated.** We do great work because that’s who we are, not because we’re told to.
* **We play to win.** We set the standard and push it higher.
* **We are problem solvers.** We take ownership, figure it out and get it done.
* **We care.** We show up with honesty, respect and real support.
* **We are fun.** We take the work seriously, not ourselves.

  

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a **Junior Account Executive/ BDR** in New York (Address: 6 St Johns Ln unit 706). This is an early-career sales role focused on creating pipeline and building the sales fundamentals needed to become a successful Account Executive at Bureau.

You’ll focus heavily on **outbound prospecting, qualification, and meeting generation** across our SMB and Mid-Market segments, with some inbound lead management. You’ll identify the right prospects, start conversations, understand their needs, and create qualified opportunities for our Account Executive team.

This is a high-activity, high-learning role for someone who is **commercially curious, competitive, persistent, and eager to build a career in sales**. You won’t be waiting around for leads to come in — the majority of your pipeline will come from your own outbound efforts.

You’ll work closely with Account Executives and sales leadership, receiving hands-on coaching while developing the skills to eventually own the full sales cycle yourself. As you grow, you may also have the opportunity to close straightforward opportunities directly, building the commercial judgment and closing skills required to progress into an Account Executive role.

Technology and AI are an important part of how we sell at Bureau. You’ll be expected to use our sales tools effectively and leverage AI to improve prospect research, personalization, outreach, productivity, and sales execution.

**Responsibilities:**

1. Outbound Prospecting & Pipeline Generation

* Build and execute outbound prospecting strategies targeting Bureau's ideal customer profile.
* Research target accounts and identify the right companies, contacts, and buying signals.
* Prospect through email, phone, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels to create new conversations.
* Build and manage active outreach sequences and consistently generate qualified meetings.
* Follow up with event, conference, and marketing-generated leads.
* Develop repeatable prospecting habits and continuously improve your approach.
* Take ownership of creating pipeline rather than relying on inbound leads.

2. Lead Qualification & Opportunity Creation

* Respond to and qualify inbound leads to determine fit, need, timing, and potential.
* Conduct initial discovery conversations to understand customer needs and identify opportunities.
* Qualify prospects against Bureau's ICP and sales criteria before handing opportunities to Account Executives.
* Book high-quality meetings that have a clear business reason to continue the conversation.
* Maintain a strong understanding of Bureau's products, value proposition, and competitive differentiation.
* Where appropriate, manage and close straightforward single-site opportunities to develop your commercial and closing skills.

3. CRM & Sales Discipline

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date activity and contact information in HubSpot.
* Log prospecting activity, meeting outcomes, next steps, and opportunity information consistently.
* Keep active outreach sequences organized and actionable.
* Use sales activity and conversion data to understand what is working and where to improve.
* Develop strong CRM and sales process habits from day one.

4. Collaboration & Handoff

**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

As a Manager of Strategic Account Management at Rippling, you will lead, coach, and scale a team of Account Managers who serve as primary relationship owners for our most Strategic customers. You will drive team strategy, mentor ICs through complex growth and retention opportunities, and foster operational excellence to achieve company targets for customer adoption, net retention, and revenue growth.

**What you will do**

* Establish and refine playbook strategies for account expansion, executive business reviews, contract renewals, and customer risk mitigation.
* Analyze account data, customer health indicators, and market trends to forecast revenue, identify growth opportunities, and mitigate churn risk across the team's portfolio.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning, team collaboration, high accountability, and customer-centricity.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 5+ years of total SaaS experience, including 3+ years of direct people management experience leading Account Management or Sales teams in the enterprise+ space.
* Consistent track record of team quota achievement across net retention, cross-sell/up-sell revenue, and customer adoption targets.
* Demonstrated expertise in sales and coaching methodologies, and developing individual contributor skillsets.
* Strong leadership agility with experience operating in high-growth, fast-paced environments, and navigating complex organizational structures.
* Proven success building and maintaining long term commercial relationships, including interfacing directly with executive buyers.
* Highly effective communication skills and exceptional EQ – able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company.
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and detail-oriented; great follow-through on projects/tasks big and small.
* Strong operational and technical acumen - you have the DNA of an engineer but choose to be in sales leadership.
* High integrity; enthusiastic about building a great company for the long term
* Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it.

* Proactively communicate with internal teams

Lockton is committed to advancing diversity and inclusion. We have a dynamic entrepreneurial culture in which our people are empowered to make a difference to better serve client needs. We are committed to giving back to our communities and we are invested in your success.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

As a Technical Account Manager, you will own the ongoing technical relationship through the entire lifecycle of customers in your portfolio, collaborating very closely alongside the Customer Success and wider account teams. This role will serve as a trusted technical advisor responsible for defining the Braze technology strategy for customers who have purchased the TAM premium service offering and helping them unlock value from their use of the Braze platform.

Your focus will be to drive value, retention, and adoption of Braze's product through the customer lifecycle, acting as the technical counterpart between Braze and your client's product and engineering team. You will be responsible for understanding your customer's needs and proactively driving forward technical initiatives that help your customers achieve their business goals.

You'll manage a portfolio of named accounts, typically in the Enterprise and Strategic classification of accounts, a tier of customers with enterprise organizational structures and architectures, posing unique geographical, scale, and complexity challenges.

This is an opportunity to bring your experience as a product and implementation expert, business analyst, problem solver, and customer success professional along with a high level of product and technical competence, delivering high-impact engagements that drive tangible outcomes for some of Braze's most advanced customers.

* You'll be responsible for client success, partnering with the Customer Success Team to own the technical relationship for your assigned accounts and help drive technical adoption, accelerated technical value, and continued technical maturity
* Help customers successfully instrument Braze across their stack and refine that instrumentation over time as their use of Braze matures and becomes even more valuable, which in turn contributes to renewals and upsells
* Facilitate conversations regarding the customers' desired use case, conducting discovery, and recommending solutions based on their unique needs and architecture
* Support and advocate for day-to-day inquiries and requests to support optimization and value through the customer lifecycle
* Empower customer product and engineering teams to use our product as independently and efficiently as possible, communicating with customers and internal teams to explain products and solutions by delivering enablement and education
* Adopt governance practices such as creating solutions documentation and building architectural diagrams, and drive progress against key technical work streams through project management
* Instill best practice and engineering excellence amongst your customer portfolio by validating product use cases and technical feasibility for product launch and translating the customers' unique requirements to Braze's Product team

**WHO YOU ARE**

* 3-5 years client-facing experience as a TAM or in a related technical area such in Implementation, Technical Support, or Solutions Architecture, for a product offering serving Enterprise/Strategic accounts
* 3+ years of technical experience in managing complex customer environments with strong product command and technical knowledge of two or more of the following: SaaS, Mobile, API, or Programming
* You are an excellent communicator (written and verbal skills), with demonstrable customer communication and coordination efforts, and the ability to take complex technical ideas and translate them to non-technical stakeholders
* You are a natural problem solver with a high level of intellectual curiosity and love working amongst a team to solve those problems
* You are able to maintain a high level of productivity, manage multiple competing priorities, and work effectively under the pressure of time constraints in a fast-paced, complex, and collaborative environment
* You may have bilingual skills beyond English that facilitate us talking with our global customer base in their native language. Please note that this is not a requirement for the role but something that we welcome in our team

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $90,000 and $130,500/year with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $102,000 and $145,000/year (including bonus or commission). In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

*Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at* *here**. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.*

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze off

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

  

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

  

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

  

**Get to Know Our Team:**

We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn, and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding, and happiness. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

* Drive adoption and growth of Agoda and Priceline marketing and visibility programs across North America.

* Support hotel partners and internal teams in identifying opportunities to increase production, conversion, and overall partner performance.

* Support quarterly planning, forecasting, and business reviews through data-driven insights.

Analytics & Operational Excellence

* Translate complex data into clear, concise recommendations for leadership

* Identify opportunities to improve workflows, reporting processes, and operational efficiency through technology and automation.
* Leverage AI and emerging technologies responsibly to improve productivity, insights generation, and decision-making.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.

* Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets.

* Working knowledge of SQL (or similar query language) and experience with BI / data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Superset, etc.) or willingness to learn quickly

* Comfortable working with AI-powered tools and adopting new technologies.

* Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal); able to explain complex topics clearly and tailor the message to different audiences.

* Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.

* Self-starter with strong ownership, accountability, and execution skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

* Strong commercial acumen and data-driven decision making.

* Proven ability to influence stakeholders across different functions and levels of the organization.
* Curiosity, ownership mindset, and a passion for driving measurable business impact.

jobs.description:
**Careers at Keel**

Keel Infrastructure is a publicly traded energy and digital infrastructure company that develops and owns data centers and power assets across North America.

At Keel, you're not just joining a company, you're helping build the infrastructure behind the future of compute.

  

**Why Keel**

We're at the intersection of energy and technology, two industries transforming in real time.

The work is complex. The pace is fast. The impact is real.

You'll be part of a team that values:

* **Ownership**— we take responsibility and follow through
* **Collaboration**— we work across teams, functions, and borders
* **Curiosity**— we ask questions and keep learning
* **Endurance**— we build for the long term

  

**What It Feels Like to Work Here**

* Fast-moving, high-growth, and hands-on
* Smart, driven people solving real challenges together
* Work that directly supports AI and next-generation infrastructure
* Room to grow, stretch, and take on more

  

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary, bonus and equity opportunities
* Comprehensive health and wellness benefits
* Retirement savings with company contribution
* Employee referral program

  

We are currently looking for a **Customer Success Manager** to join our team

  

**Role Summary**

Keel Infrastructure is seeking a Customer Success Manager in Program Delivery to serve as the tenant's day-to-day point of contact and make sure the tenant's needs are captured at intake and delivered through design, construction, and operations handover. Reporting to the VP, Data Center Program Delivery, this role acts as the liaison between the tenant and the development team on behalf of Keel.

The role works closely with Tenants, Leasing and Corp Dev, Pre-Construction, the Program Coordinator, Engineering, Project Controls, Construction Delivery, and Operations.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Intake with Leasing:** Support Leasing in collecting tenant project requirements and prepare a Tenant Deliverable Package (Basis of Design, specifications, drawings, models, OPRs, reporting standards, delivery strategy, acceptance criteria, schedule expectations, assumptions/constraints).
* **Collaboration with Engineering, Pre-Construction, and Construction:** Maintain the tenant's deliverable package requirements from intake through operational handover as the source of truth for each work stream.
* **Stakeholder Relationship & Reporting:** Own the tenant relationship day to day as single point of contact; run regular touchpoints and action items; prepare tenant-facing reports with Project Controls and the Program Coordinator covering RFIs, schedule, progress, risks, and upcoming decisions.
* **Change Management:** Manage a change control process to receive, log, and route tenant change requests and issues to closure; evaluate scope, cost, and schedule impact with Project Controls; escalate to the VP of DC Program Delivery when a decision or exception is needed.
* **Tenant Expectations:** Ensure metrics and expectation criteria are included to meet tenant milestones through design, construction, and commissioning; obtain approvals and facilitate feedback through design reviews, construction milestones, and tenant handover readiness.
* **Project Close Out:** Deliver a complete close out package with the Program Coordinator; work with Construction to validate punch list items; coordinate with the Director of Quality Assurance / Commissioning and VP of Operations on testing and commissioning requirements.
* **Commercial Awareness:** Deal terms belong to Leasing and Corp Dev; surface commercial questions and misalignment to them early, and address technical, cost, and schedule responses with Engineering and Project Controls.
* **Technical Acumen:** Evaluate technical information from tenants to flag scope gaps or scope creep; understand the flow of data center design and construction phases from concept through completion.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 8+ years in a tenant/client-facing role on behalf of a complex mission critical project, providing program management or customer account roles in construction, infrastructure, data center, HPC/AI, or a comparable capital-project environment.
* Working knowledge of construction delivery, schedules, and change management; able to read technical data, drawings, and schedules.
* Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable leading tenant meetings, reporting on project challenges, and determining the correct point to escalate with solutions.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, business, sales, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred**

* PMP, CAPM, CCM, or similar credential.

  

**Success Measures**

* Tenant requirements are captured at intake and the hand over checklist is received by Engineering and Construction teams at LOI.
* Tenant-driven changes are evaluated for scope, cost, and schedule impacts, with clear impact assessments provided to the tenant.
* Tenant change requests and issues are acknowledged and closed on a tracked timeline aligned with contract and schedule dates.
* Tenant commissioning requirements are delivered and accepted at handover.
* Tenant reports are accurate, on time, and consistent with internal reporting.

**Work Environment:**

* Location: New York Office
* Schedule: On-site a minimum of three (3) days per week.
* Travel: Periodic travel to project sites, vendor facilities, and partner locations as required.

The base salary range is $115,000-$155,000. Our total compensation package combines this base salary with a bonus target and participates in our yearly equity grant. We offer a fantastic benefits package and many perks. There's a top-down emphasis on amazing work culture at our organization.

jobs.description:
The Executive Assistant, Faculty serves as the primary source of administrative support for two research

groups and their leaders and will be responsible for varied tasks supporting biomedical academic research labs.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Manages complex calendars of group leaders.
* Schedules meetings, conference calls and interviews, responds to invitations, reserves locations, manages attendee lists etc.
* Works through scheduling roadblocks using independent judgment and discretion  
  wherever possible.
* Ensures group leaders are prepared for meetings and assists them with best managing

their time.

* Coordinates events, meetings and conferences, including A/V needs, catering, confirming attendees, booking locations, etc.
* Coordinates extensive travel arrangements. Prepares itineraries and documents to facilitate

domestic and international travel by group members and job candidates.

* Prepares and processes expense reimbursements and tracks outstanding expenses.
* Maintains and updates group websites as papers are published and grants are funded.
* Supports group leaders when they are teaching, e.g. organizes the course calendar, arranges meetings with students, maintains the course website.

Performs other administrative duties as requested, such as;

* Proofreads, reviews and edits documents with excellent attention to detail.
* Attends meetings to take notes, tracking action items and following up accordingly.
* Liaises with students and administrators at NYGC and other NY institutes (primarily Columbia University and NYU), for example to set up new hires, secure space, order computers and materials.
* Orders office supplies.
* Performs filing, scanning and record-keeping.
* Provides administrative support (if other priorities permit) to other NYGC faculty on an occasional basis, as a backup for other administrative staff.

**Position Requirements**

* 2+ years of administrative experience, including calendar maintenance;
* Strong writing and editing skills and excellent attention-to-detail;
* Excellent competence with computers and modern communication tools, such MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel), Slack, Gemini/ChatGPT;
* Exceptional time management and organizational skills, with the ability to appropriately balance multiple, competing priorities;
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills;
* Ability to anticipate needs and take action without requiring detailed direction in relation to routine responsibilities;
* Ability to maintain the highest level of confidentiality and to engender trust;
* Experience working in an academic, scientific or non-profit environment preferred; and, undergraduate degree preferred.

**About the Sanjana Lab**

The Sanjana Lab develops technologies to understand how human genetic variants cause diseases. The lab employs a multi-disciplinary approach, combining genome engineering, pooled genetic screens, molecular genomics, synthetic biology, and imaging, to dissect the inner workings of the human genome and to develop next-generation therapies for diverse diseases, including cancer, rare inherited disorders, brain disorders, autoimmunity and others. The Sanjana lab is comprised of molecular engineers, biologists, neuroscientists, computer scientists and bioscience entrepreneurs who are passionate about creating new technologies for genomics and advancing human health. The lab is also affiliated with the Department of Biology at New York University. http://sanjanalab.org/

**About the Phatnani Lab**

The Phatnani Lab applies integrated multi-omic approaches to understand the molecular mechanisms underlying neurodegenerative diseases. The lab employs a multi-disciplinary approach, combining whole-genome sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, single-nucleus epigenomics and RNA-seq, and multiplex protein imaging, to dissect the complex interplay between neurons and non-neuronal cells in the brain and spinal cord, to study diseases including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), frontotemporal dementia (FTD), and other neurodegenerative disorders. The Phatnani lab is comprised of computational biologists and basic scientists who are passionate about building tools and resources for the research community and advancing our understanding of human brain health. The lab is affiliated with the Department of Neurology at Columbia University. https://www.nygenome.org/science-technology/faculty-labs/phatnani-lab/

Colonial has provided a wide range of opportunities for job candidates who are highly qualified, skilled, motivated and team players. Employees find exciting opportunities to grow and develop their careers at a stable company which offers a generous compensation and benefits package that includes annual incentive bonuses, retirement plans, insurance coverage and a host of other features that support a happy, active, productive and rewarding life. Come to Colonial, a great place to work, where people matter most, and where safety 24/7 is paramount.

**Ready to work for Colonial Pipeline Company?**

Are you intrigued by the thought of being part of revolutionizing the energy industry and a new era in the pipeline industry? **What is it that we do at Colonial Pipeline Company?**

Colonial Pipeline is the largest refined products pipeline in the United States, transporting more than 100 million gallons or 2.5 million barrels per day. Colonial transports various grades of gasoline, diesel fuel, home heating oil, jet fuel, and fuels for the U.S. military through a pipeline system. Colonial transports approximately 45 percent of all fuel consumed on the East Coast, providing refined products to more than 50 million Americans.

We’re looking for an organized, analytical Public Awareness Program Coordinator to help advance pipeline safety awareness, regulatory compliance, and strong stakeholder relationships across Colonial Pipeline’s footprint. You will work cross-functionally with Communications, Operations, Right of Way, Projects, emergency responders, public officials, landowners, schools, excavators, and external consultants to deliver consistent safety messaging and improve program effectiveness.

If you’re a collaborative professional who values safety, organization, continuous improvement, and public engagement, this may be the perfect opportunity for you.

=======================

**Public Awareness Program Logistics**
--------------------------------------

* Coordinate logistics for public awareness safety messaging campaigns across multiple communication platforms, including tracking and documenting program activities.

* Assess program effectiveness through surveys and data analysis; identify strengths and gaps and recommend enhancements that support continuous improvement.
* Maintain program documentation in accordance with regulatory requirements and serve as a primary point of contact for Public Awareness regulatory inspections.
* Coordinate with external consultants supporting databases, mailings, meetings, and other outreach activities.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Program Support**
--------------------------------------------

* Support cross-functional efforts to strengthen relationships with landowners, emergency responders, public officials, schools, excavators, and other critical stakeholders.
* Partner with Operations, Right of Way, Projects, Communications, and other internal teams to promote consistent pipeline safety messaging and stakeholder engagement.
* Help address stakeholder questions and concerns related to Colonial’s assets, operations, and activities.
* Provide education to internal stakeholders on the Public Awareness program database and support ongoing platform improvements.
* Ensure the Public Awareness database is maintained, regularly updated, accessible, and effective for program needs.

**Data Management & Reporting**
-------------------------------

* Compile statistical and compliance reporting for Damage Prevention, Land Management, Public Awareness, Integrity Management, Tank Integrity, Corrosion Prevention, and other Asset Integrity activities.
* Support periodic departmental reports and annual system integrity and performance management reporting.
* Provide data and reporting support for risk management and analysis activities.
* Document process recommendations, outcomes, and opportunities for improvement.
* Provide ad hoc reporting and analytical support across Asset Integrity as needed.

**Administrative & Business Continuity Support**
------------------------------------------------

* Support recurring Asset Integrity budgets, funding approvals, and related administrative needs.
* Assist with the maintenance, formatting, and approval of procedures, engineering standards, manuals, and other departmental documentation.
* Develop advanced knowledge of the Public Awareness Manager function and the Safety Management System to support business continuity when needed.
* Support emergency response activities, including training, short-term travel, and backfill responsibilities, as assigned.

**Communication & Collaboration**
---------------------------------

* Communicate clearly and professionally with internal teams, external stakeholders, consultants, and regulatory representatives.
* Build productive working relationships across functions and translate program expectations into clear, actionable guidance.
* Use critical thinking, problem-solving, and sound judgment to resolve issues and support program strategy.

  + Partner account planning
  + QBRs & JBCs
  + Joint pipeline reviews and forecasting
  + Travel within your assigned territory to further support and develop your channel partners, attend and/or exhibit at industry trade shows and conferences as necessary

* Work with the channel team and cross functionally with marketing, support, product, success, direct sales, and leadership teams to identify key issues and to tackle any that impede partner/client performance

### **What You'll Need**

* Three to five years of experience in partner, channel or vendor type sales management
* Sales or channel experience in SaaS, technology or marketing services
* Ability to work in a high growth company, effectively balancing autonomy, alignment and direction
* An ability to perform analytics to evaluate partner success, pipeline and territory requirements
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, with strong ability to build, persuade and communicate business rationale
* Proven effectiveness collaborating in small teams and desire to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment
* Comfortable communicating with all levels of management
* Ability and willingness to travel 20-25%
* Strong organizational skills and professional business practices

*f you do not meet all the requirements listed, we still encourage you to apply! No job description is perfect, and we may also have another opportunity that aligns with your skills and experience.*

### 

### **Additional Perks**

* Healthcare (one option covered at 100% for employees), Dental & Vision Coverage
* Competitive HSA with company matching
* Paid parental leave
* Flexible vacation policy
* 401K options with company dollar-for-dollar match
* Employee stock options available from day one
* $2,000 annual educational allowance
* Catered lunch every Tuesday \* an in-office perk
* MARTA transportation or office parking expenses covered
* Employee charitable donation company match, up to $500 annually
* Regular company outings and events
* Hybrid work options with $500 office stipend to set up your home office
* Designated bike storage

  

***This position is based out of our Atlanta office. Through December 2026, employees are expected to work in the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays.***

***Beginning in January 2027, CallRail will transition to a 3 day hybrid model, with in-office days on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays.***

Learn more: https://www.callrail.com/about/

**You Are Welcome Here**

CallRail understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company's core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, and persons of all sexual orientations and gender identities and expressions. In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example - she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).  
  
**Continuous adoption of AI technologies is essential to this role. You will be expected to leverage AI platforms to streamline operations, solve complex problems, and stay ahead of industry benchmarks.**

Account Manager | Insurance & Financial Services

**Atlanta, GA | Full-Time | In-Office + Limited WFH**

Angie Sue Brown State Farm Agency opened in 2018 and is located right by Piedmont Park, where Midtown, Virginia-Highland, Ansley Park, and Morningside come together.

We’re a local insurance and financial services agency, but relationships are really at the center of what we do. We want our customers to know who we are, trust us, and feel like they have a real person they can call when they need help.

That same philosophy applies to our team.

We’re a small, close-knit office where your work matters and your contribution is noticed. We like to have fun, we support each other, and we genuinely enjoy the people we work with—but we also work hard.

**We want to be transparent about that from the beginning.**

This is not a position where you wait for work to come to you. You’ll have goals, make calls, follow up consistently, learn a lot, and be expected to contribute to the success of the agency. In return, you'll have the opportunity to earn more based on your performance, build valuable professional skills, and create a real career path for yourself.

**Help people make smart insurance decisions.**

You'll work with new customers to understand what they need and recommend coverage that makes sense for them. You'll have access to 100+ product options across auto, home, renters, life, health, business insurance, and more.

**Sell—and follow up.**

Sales is an important part of this role. You'll work active leads, talk with people who are already shopping for insurance, follow up with prospects, and ask for their business. There are monthly sales expectations, and we'll be upfront about what those are.

**Build relationships, not just quotes.**

We're not interested in winning someone's business solely because we're the cheapest option. We want customers who value having an agency and a team they can actually rely on. Your job is to help create that relationship from the first conversation and advise them on your recommendations.

**Learn an industry.**

You do NOT need to come to us knowing insurance. We'll teach you. What we can't teach as easily is curiosity, work ethic, accountability, and a willingness to learn. **Those are qualities you need to bring with you.**

**Get out into Atlanta.**

We're active in our community. You may join us at festivals, home shows, local events, referral visits, business partnerships, charitable initiatives, and other opportunities to meet the people and businesses around us.

* You're motivated by goals and like seeing the results of your work.
* You aren't afraid to pick up the phone.
* You can stay organized when there are a lot of things happening at once.
* You like people and genuinely enjoy helping them.
* You want feedback and opportunities to get better.
* You're comfortable being held accountable for your results.
* You enjoy being part of a small team where everyone contributes.
* You're looking for more than "just a job" and want somewhere you can grow.

* 1–3+ years of professional work experience
* Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
* Excellent phone presence
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and stay organized
* Self-motivated and comfortable working toward measurable goals
* Team-oriented and willing to jump in when needed
* Interested in continued personal and professional development
* Comfortable working in a small-office environment
* Ability to pass a background check
* Property & Casualty and Life & Health licenses—or willingness to obtain them before your start date

Interested in eventually owning a business yourself? Even better. For the right person, this role can be an opportunity to learn how a successful insurance agency operates from the inside and potentially prepare for agency ownership in the future.

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM

**Location:** Atlanta, GA – in office

**Work From Home:** Two days per month after training

**After-hours/Saturdays:** Optional

**Compensation:** Competitive base salary + commission

**Average Total Compensation:** $65,000–$95,000\*

**Benefits include:**

* 10 days PTO to start
* 401(k) with company match
* Life & disability benefits
* Teladoc health service
* $500 signing bonus
* Monthly promos to earn extra money or PTO
* Paid training and professional development
* Performance-based commission opportunities

**A note about compensation:** This is a sales-driven position, so total earnings will depend on individual performance. We believe in being transparent about expectations and earning potential throughout the interview process.

One More Thing

We're not looking for someone who checks every box perfectly.

We're looking for someone who is **dependable, motivated, coachable, good with people, and willing to work hard.** If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

**Angie Sue Brown State Farm Agency**

1440 Dutch Valley Pl NE, Unit 755

Atlanta, GA 30324
