**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Position Title:** **F****ield Marketing Operations Support (Embedded)**

  

**On board experiential marketing**

On Board Experiential (OBE) is an award-winning, full-service, experience-led agency that creates meaningful brand experiences worldwide. Recognized by Event Marketer as one of the best places to work in events, our clients include Nike, Meta, JPMorgan Chase, Sephora, Starbucks, and Converse, to name a few. We work out of our homes and physical offices in San Francisco, Los Angeles, NYC, and London, or wherever our adventures take us! OBE is also a founding member of The ADD Collective, extending our reach and resources while staying true to our core capabilities.

The most important part of our business is our people. They are hardworking, imaginative and make magic happen on the regular. But behind each majestic activation is a human deserving of a healthy work-life balance. That's why we believe in recovery days, happy hours, friendly but competitive fitness challenges, and OBE offsites.

We show up for each other — in open conversations that heal, inspire, and bring us closer. We want to hear about your lived experiences and unique perspectives. Being unapologetically yourself isn't just welcome here. It's part of the job.

  

**SUMMARY OF POSITION**

OBE is seeking a Field Marketing Operations Support professional to join our team and be embedded within a client's Enterprise Field Marketing organization, supporting field programs across the Americas region. This role turns approved field marketing plans into coordinated execution — owning program management and marketing operations across the full event lifecycle — while working directly inside the client's systems, meetings, and planning rhythms as a trusted extension of their team.

While the role is operationally focused, the ideal candidate brings enough command of enterprise sales cycles, account-based marketing, and field marketing strategy to be more than an executor: someone who understands the business behind the events, sits close to sales, and proactively flags risks and recommends changes rather than simply reporting status.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**

**Program Coordination & Project Management**

* Build and maintain workback plans, trackers, approvals, and handoffs across the event lifecycle.

* Provide status updates and proactively escalate risks to the client's field marketing leadership.

* Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders to keep programs on track from planning through execution.

**Registration & Attendee Operations**

* Own registration setup, RSVP management, and attendee communications for events.

* Track attendee data and ensure accuracy across systems throughout the event lifecycle.

**Seller Enablement**

* Build and maintain seller toolkits, outreach cadences, and audience segmentation for sales teams.

* Coordinate send-on-behalf communications and manage review and approval cycles with sellers.

**Executive Readiness**

* Coordinate briefing documents, executive profiles, and content inputs for executive participation in events.

* Manage review cycles and final deployment of executive-facing materials.

**Campaign & Lead Operations**

* Set up SFDC campaigns, manage lead uploads, and coordinate with Marketing Operations on data quality.

* Perform quality checks to ensure accurate campaign and lead tracking.

**Reporting & Follow-Up**

* Build and maintain post-event dashboards and reporting.

* Track follow-up actions and maintain visibility into outstanding items for the client's team.

**Strategic Fluency & Account Support**

* Understand the client's product, sales, and GTM motions well enough to align field programs to broader marketing and revenue goals.

* Sit in on sales calls and leadership meetings as needed to understand full account context, not just the events being supported.

* Bring a working knowledge of account-based marketing (ABM) principles to support the build-out and execution of long-term, account-specific marketing plans, typically spanning 12 to 18 month enterprise sales cycles.

* Analyze what is and isn't working from an event and program perspective, and proactively recommend adjustments.

  

**summary of position**

**Education / Experience**

* 3 to 6 years of experience in field marketing, marketing operations, event marketing, or program management, ideally supporting B2B or Enterprise organizations.

* Experience working within enterprise marketing and sales tech stacks (e.g., Salesforce/SFDC, marketing automation platforms, event registration tools).

* Exposure to enterprise sales cycles and account-based marketing (ABM) strongly preferred.

* BA/BS in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field; relevant work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

**Essential Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Strong program and project management skills; able to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, and approvals simultaneously.

* Familiarity with Salesforce (SFDC) campaign setup, lead management, and marketing operations workflows.

* Working understanding of account-based marketing (ABM) strategy and execution.

* Comfort operating inside a client's systems, tools, and meeting cadences as an embedded team member.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trust with sales, marketing, and executive stakeholders.

* Analytical mindset; able to synthesize event and program performance data into clear, actionable recommendations.

* High attention to detail and follow-through, particularly around registration, data accuracy, and reporting.

**Other Qualities and Skills**

* Comfortable embedding within a client's team and adapting to their systems, culture, and cadence.

* Proactive and solutions-oriented; anticipates risks and brings recommendations, not just status updates.

* High energy and flexibility to support event timelines, which may include non-traditional hours.

### **About the Role**

Together AI is looking for an Event Marketing Manager to help execute high-impact events that bring our brand, technology, and community to life.

You'll work closely with our Field Marketing & Events team, primarily supporting major industry conferences and tradeshows, while also contributing to flagship first-party events, experiential activations, and other strategic programs. You'll own key aspects of event planning and execution, from logistics and sponsorships to onsite operations and post-event follow-up.

This is an opportunity for an events marketer ready to take on more ownership, gain experience across different event formats, and learn how exceptional events drive business impact, from brand awareness and community engagement to pipeline generation and customer relationships.

### **Responsibilities**

#### **Execute Industry Conferences & Tradeshows**

* Plan and execute key workstreams for major industry conferences and tradeshows, including sponsorship deliverables, booth logistics, vendors, staffing, shipping, and onsite operations.
* Coordinate customer and prospect meetings, executive engagements, and other activities surrounding conferences.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, and cross-functional teams to align event objectives, timelines, and execution.
* Support pre-event promotion, lead capture, post-event follow-up, and reporting to maximize event impact.

#### **Support flagship events & experiential programs**

* Help plan and execute Together AI's flagship first-party events, executive programs, and experiential activations.
* Own assigned event workstreams, coordinating vendors, production, logistics, and onsite execution.
* Collaborate with internal teams and agencies to deliver thoughtful, memorable experiences that reflect the Together AI brand.

#### **Manage flagship event sponsorships**

* Coordinate sponsorship programs for Together AI's flagship events, including sponsor communications, deliverables, branding, and onsite activations.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for sponsors, ensuring commitments are fulfilled and partners have a great experience.
* Manage sponsorship timelines, trackers, and post-event reporting.

#### **Drive event operations & performance**

* Manage event timelines, budgets, vendors, contracts, invoices, and logistics across assigned programs.
* Own swag and branded merchandise programs, including sourcing, vendor management, inventory, fulfillment, and distribution across events and marketing initiatives.
* Maintain event documentation, attendee data, project trackers, and operational workflows.
* Research and evaluate new event and sponsorship opportunities based on audience fit, cost, and business objectives.
* Partner with Marketing and Sales to track event performance, including engagement, meetings, leads, and pipeline influence.
* Identify ways to streamline processes and improve event execution.

### **Requirements**

* 3+ years of experience in event marketing, field marketing, conference and tradeshow management, or a related B2B marketing role, ideally in technology.
* Hands-on experience executing in-person events, including vendor management, logistics, sponsorships, and onsite operations.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple programs, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with confidence working across internal teams and external partners.
* A proactive, resourceful mindset with strong problem-solving skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* An appreciation for thoughtfully executed, high-quality event experiences.
* An understanding of how events contribute to brand awareness, demand generation, and business growth.
* Curiosity about AI and experience using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini to improve workflows and efficiency.
* High agency, adaptability, and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with ambiguity.
* Ability to travel up to 30–40% based on event schedules, including international travel.

### **About Together AI**

Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.

We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance, and other benefits. The US base salary range for this full-time position is: $120,000 - $150,000 + equity + benefits. **About the Company:**

GreenWaste has been an industry leader in recycling and waste diversion for 40 years and is on a growth trajectory after private equity investment in 2021. Our business was founded on principles of environmental sustainability, and innovation is a cornerstone of our ongoing operations and growth strategy. GreenWaste specializes in all aspects of material collection, processing, and sales, tailoring our service offerings to the unique needs of our customers and communities, and helping to shape the evolution of the solid waste and recycling industry. We work directly with 20+ municipalities and 50+ jurisdictions, operate highly regulated facilities in 10+ locations, and have 1,000+ employees.

**Position** **Summary:**

The Environmental Outreach Coordinator delivers outreach and education across assigned jurisdictions to support community engagement, regulatory compliance, and waste-diversion goals. Up to sixty percent of the role is spent in the field, conducting waste audits by inspecting residential carts and commercial waste and recycling containers to assess sorting practices, identify contamination, and support diversion efforts. The Coordinator also educates residents and businesses on proper waste sorting and diversion practices, participates in community events, and delivers presentations to schools, community groups, and other audiences. Assignments may span multiple jurisdictions based on contract and operational requirements.

new_jobs.title: Program Coordinator, Investor Talent
new_jobs.description:
**About the Alpha Engine Department**

The Alpha Engine is responsible for Pure Alpha, Bridgewater’s flagship alpha strategy launched in 1991. Our aim in Pure Alpha is to generate high and consistent returns, uncorrelated to markets and other managers over time. We pursue this by systematically deploying our fundamental understanding of markets and economies to trade long, short, and relative value across roughly 200 liquid public markets.

**About Your Role**

The Investor Talent team partners with investors across Bridgewater’s investment departments on how the firm identifies, assesses, develops, and compensates its investors, at a time of significant change for the firm. The team is building as it goes, which leaves real room to shape how things run.

The Program Coordinator role is an execution-focused role at the center of how the Investor Talent team runs. You’ll work directly with the team's manager, leads, and senior investors, bringing tight execution and project management skills to translate priorities into practical plans and drive investor programs from planning through delivery. Your book of work will shift with the calendar, with management of the team's operations and programs taking up the majority of your time during peak periods.

We are a nimble, hands-on team where every member contributes to the operational work through to the outcomes that make our programs successful (e.g., attending the events that you help shape and plan). We’re looking for someone who takes pride in getting the details right, follows through reliably, and is equally willing to coordinate calendars, pull ongoing metrics, or improve and own a process. It’s a fast-moving environment with a lot to learn, so curiosity and adaptability will go a long way. Over time, the right person will take on broader project management ownership, improve how our programs run, and manage increasingly complex workstreams.

You will drive the following responsibilities:

* **Primary partner in running a tight talent ecosystem:** Partner with the team’s manager and leads to understand the broad mission of investor talent, and own coordination at the goal level rather than the task level. In practice, this means owning the calendar, meeting logistics, agendas, and program sessions and materials, and anticipating needs before you’re asked.
* **Owner of the team’s management machines:** Build, run, and continuously improve the recurring processes that keep the team operating, including review cycles, security, and operations. Keep meetings, follow-ups, and commitments on track across these processes. Own knowledge management across SharePoint, Confluence, and distribution lists, with room to shape how it works and evolves.
* **Project manager for key programs:** Own day-to-day execution of the summer internship and investor class, from scheduling and communications to materials and events. Translate priorities into clear plans with timelines, owners, and dependencies, and adapt as needs change. Anticipate risks, resolve bottlenecks, and hold stakeholders accountable to their commitments, escalating with sound judgment when needed. Track engagement metrics to assess how well each program is working.
* **Key driver of technology and AI to raise team productivity:** Use technology and AI to improve how the team works, from automating coordination and communications to streamlining reviews and programs. Proactively look for ways to run things better, and connect the dots across workstreams so improvements spread.

The anticipated onsite requirement for this role is four days per week, primarily at our New York City campus.

**Minimum Qualifications**

You have a passion for running and improving processes and take pride in making others’ worlds run smoothly. You are proactive and comfortable holding others accountable directly and respectfully, including more senior colleagues.

* 2+ years of experience in coordination, project management, business operations, or a similar role, in a fast-paced, stakeholder-facing environment
* Strong attention to detail and operational discipline, with the ability to prioritize across multiple concurrent workstreams and adapt to ambiguity
* Excellent written and verbal communication with a range of stakeholders
* Ability to work flexible hours as needed, e.g., some evenings or onsite additional days for key program events

Bridgewater Associates is a global macro investment firm, founded in 1975, whose mission is to develop a fundamental, cause-and-effect understanding of how markets and economies work—and translate that understanding into insights, returns, and solutions that help the world’s leading institutional investors solve their most important investment challenges.

Bureau is a founder-led global company built around a simple belief: better spaces make better work.

Today, we make soundproof office booths that help people focus, meet and think. But our ambition is much bigger than what we sell. We want to shape how people do their best work, and build a company that can make a meaningful dent in the way work feels.

new_jobs.description:
The Executive Assistant, Faculty serves as the primary source of administrative support for two research

groups and their leaders and will be responsible for varied tasks supporting biomedical academic research labs.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Manages complex calendars of group leaders.
* Schedules meetings, conference calls and interviews, responds to invitations, reserves locations, manages attendee lists etc.
* Works through scheduling roadblocks using independent judgment and discretion  
  wherever possible.
* Ensures group leaders are prepared for meetings and assists them with best managing

their time.

* Coordinates events, meetings and conferences, including A/V needs, catering, confirming attendees, booking locations, etc.
* Coordinates extensive travel arrangements. Prepares itineraries and documents to facilitate

domestic and international travel by group members and job candidates.

* Prepares and processes expense reimbursements and tracks outstanding expenses.
* Maintains and updates group websites as papers are published and grants are funded.
* Supports group leaders when they are teaching, e.g. organizes the course calendar, arranges meetings with students, maintains the course website.

Performs other administrative duties as requested, such as;

* Proofreads, reviews and edits documents with excellent attention to detail.
* Attends meetings to take notes, tracking action items and following up accordingly.
* Liaises with students and administrators at NYGC and other NY institutes (primarily Columbia University and NYU), for example to set up new hires, secure space, order computers and materials.
* Orders office supplies.
* Performs filing, scanning and record-keeping.
* Provides administrative support (if other priorities permit) to other NYGC faculty on an occasional basis, as a backup for other administrative staff.

**Position Requirements**

* 2+ years of administrative experience, including calendar maintenance;
* Strong writing and editing skills and excellent attention-to-detail;
* Excellent competence with computers and modern communication tools, such MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel), Slack, Gemini/ChatGPT;
* Exceptional time management and organizational skills, with the ability to appropriately balance multiple, competing priorities;
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills;
* Ability to anticipate needs and take action without requiring detailed direction in relation to routine responsibilities;
* Ability to maintain the highest level of confidentiality and to engender trust;
* Experience working in an academic, scientific or non-profit environment preferred; and, undergraduate degree preferred.

**About the Sanjana Lab**

The Sanjana Lab develops technologies to understand how human genetic variants cause diseases. The lab employs a multi-disciplinary approach, combining genome engineering, pooled genetic screens, molecular genomics, synthetic biology, and imaging, to dissect the inner workings of the human genome and to develop next-generation therapies for diverse diseases, including cancer, rare inherited disorders, brain disorders, autoimmunity and others. The Sanjana lab is comprised of molecular engineers, biologists, neuroscientists, computer scientists and bioscience entrepreneurs who are passionate about creating new technologies for genomics and advancing human health. The lab is also affiliated with the Department of Biology at New York University. http://sanjanalab.org/

**About the Phatnani Lab**

The Phatnani Lab applies integrated multi-omic approaches to understand the molecular mechanisms underlying neurodegenerative diseases. The lab employs a multi-disciplinary approach, combining whole-genome sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, single-nucleus epigenomics and RNA-seq, and multiplex protein imaging, to dissect the complex interplay between neurons and non-neuronal cells in the brain and spinal cord, to study diseases including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), frontotemporal dementia (FTD), and other neurodegenerative disorders. The Phatnani lab is comprised of computational biologists and basic scientists who are passionate about building tools and resources for the research community and advancing our understanding of human brain health. The lab is affiliated with the Department of Neurology at Columbia University. https://www.nygenome.org/science-technology/faculty-labs/phatnani-lab/

  

**Competencies**

* Technical and Professional Skills: Consistently demonstrates skills and knowledge relevant for current role; strives to expand the depth and breadth of technical and professional skills; works with a high level of integrity; exhibits focus and discipline; appropriately prioritizes, manages expectations and delivers on commitments.
* Collaborative & Communicative: Models collaboration and teamwork; brings out the best in others; effectively works with all levels, internally and externally; respects and embraces diversity of perspective; communicates clearly and listens carefully; uses good judgment as to what to communicate and when to do so.
* Adaptable & Innovative: Adaptable and embraces change; develops new insights and pursues improvements and efficiency; fosters exchange of new ideas and willing to challenge the status quo; takes initiative and is solution-oriented; engages in work with passion and curiosity.

**Work Location**

This position is based onsite at the New York Genome Center.

**Salary & Benefits**

The pay range for this position is $70,000-80,000 per year; the base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

In addition, NYGC offers a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits as well as generous time off. This includes Medical/Dental/Vision for employees & dependent(s); Vacation, Holidays, Sick, and Other Leave, including a paid winter break; a 401(k) match; Life Insurance; Flexible Spending Accounts; employee Tuition

The Community Manager is responsible for the overall management and operation of an assigned property. The role includes ensuring property performance meets MMG Management’s standards and expectations in terms of occupancy, financial objectives, resident satisfaction, and overall maintenance. The Community Manager leads the on-site team, oversees daily operations, and ensures the property runs smoothly while adhering to MMG’s mission and core values.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Property Operations Management:

* Oversee daily operations of the property, ensuring compliance with MMG policies and procedures as well as local, state, and federal laws.
* Conduct regular property inspections to ensure a high standard of cleanliness, curb appeal, and maintenance.
* Conduct regular file audits to ensure and maintain compliance with MMG policies and procedures as well as local, state, and federal laws.
* Ensure completion of daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual tasks.
* Address resident concerns and resolve issues promptly and professionally to maintain a high level of resident satisfaction.
* Proactively develop solution plans for any identified problems or inefficiencies related to property operations, maintenance, or resident issues.
* Ensure timely and efficient execution of approved plans, following up on progress and making adjustments as necessary to meet property performance goals.

2. Leasing & Occupancy Management:

* Manage the leasing process to ensure high occupancy rates.
* Monitor market trends and recommend competitive rental pricing to maximize occupancy.
* Oversee and support leasing team efforts in handling inquiries, conducting tours, and securing new leases.
* Ensure timely processing and management of lease renewals and notices to vacate.

3. Financial Management:

* Assist in development of and manage the property’s budget, ensuring financial goals are achieved.
* Monitor rent collections, delinquencies, and accounts receivable, acting to minimize loss and optimize revenue.
* Review financial reports, including rent rolls, profit and loss statements, and expense tracking, ensuring accuracy and performance alignment with company and ownership goals.
* Ensure invoices and bills are received accurately within 48 hours of services rendered or per scheduled timeline.
* Timely and accurate invoice and bill entry into property management software within 24 hours of receipt of invoices or billing statements.

4. Maintenance & Vendor Management:

* Coordinate and oversee maintenance requests, ensuring timely response and quality workmanship.
* Develop and maintain vendor relationships, negotiating contracts for services such as landscaping, cleaning, and repairs.
* Ensure preventive maintenance programs are implemented and executed consistently to maintain property value.
* Follow vendor selection and set up policies and procedures

5. Leadership & Team Growth:

* Provide leadership, ongoing training, and direction to the on-site leasing and maintenance teams.
* Recruit, train, and onboard new team members in coordination with MMG Policies and standards.
* Conduct performance reviews, provide feedback, and ensure ongoing training and development.
* Foster a positive team environment, promoting MMG’s values of employee engagement and development.
* Prepare staff schedules to ensure optimized daily operations functionality and goals.
* Regularly conduct staff meetings discussing and implementing goals, job duties, achievements, and needs.
* Ensure accurate and timely reporting of employee paid hours, commission, bonuses, and other staff compensation items.

6. Marketing & Residential Retention:

* Develop and implement marketing strategies to attract new residents and retain current tenants.
* Organize and participate in resident events and initiatives to foster a sense of community and improve resident retention.
* Maintain a professional and approachable presence at the property to ensure excellent customer service and community relations.
* Become active in local business community to develop positive rapport.

7. Compliance & Risk Management:

* Ensure the property complies with Fair Housing laws and all other applicable regulations.
* Manage risk by adhering to safety protocols and addressing safety concerns on the property.
* Handle legal issues such as evictions, lease violations, and legal notices in accordance with MMG and local regulations with communication and collaboration with Regional Director and Portfolio Manager.

8. Reporting & Communication:

* Prepare and submit accurate and timely weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports on occupancy, financial performance, maintenance activities, and other key metrics by deadlines.
* Maintain open communication with the Regional Property Director and Portfolio Manager, providing updates on property performance, challenges, and successes.

**Work Context:**

Communication:

* Required to frequently communicate efficiently, accurately, and timely via email, phone, or specified applications.

Role Importance:

* Community Managers play a crucial role in overseeing all aspects of a financial asset while maintaining resident satisfaction. They are responsible for managing budgets, supervising staff, and ensuring the properties under their care are well-maintained and profitable.

Responsibility for Others:

* Community Managers are responsible for their teams. They are to uphold policy, assess deficiencies, ensure proper training, completion of tasks, and hold teams accountable for shortcomings.

Work Setting:

* Community Manager is an in-office position to be done at a specific assigned location.

* Business casual attire require. Please see personal appearance policy for specifications.

This position works in person Monay–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m., across multiple Community Food Center and retail partner locations throughout the Atlanta area.

**Who We Are:**

The Atlanta Community Food Bank is committed to ending hunger in our community by leveraging food, dedicated people, and innovative solutions to ensure that no one has to worry about their next meal. Since 1979, we’ve provided vital resources to a growing network of nonprofit partners, including food pantries, community kitchens, childcare centers, night shelters, and senior centers. Today, we proudly serve over 700 partners across 29 counties in metro Atlanta and north Georgia, working together to create a hunger-free future.

**Where You’ll Work:**

Program / Division

**About the Role:**

The Delivery Operations Coordinator supports the daily transportation and delivery operations for the Atlanta Community Food Bank’s Community Food Centers across the Atlanta area. This position safely operates a non-CDL box truck to transport food, equipment, and materials between retail partners and assigned Community Food Center locations, ensuring timely and accurate deliveries.

The role includes completing vehicle inspections, coordinating pickup and delivery schedules, and communicating with retail partners and Community Food Center management. Strong time management, attention to safety and food handling practices, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment are essential.

**What You’ll Do:**

**Transportation & Delivery Operations**

* Safely operate a company box truck to transport food, equipment, and materials between retail partners and assigned Community Food Center locations.
* Complete timely pickups and deliveries according to established schedules and assigned routes.
* Plan and adjust routes as needed based on traffic, weather, construction, and other conditions to support safe and on-time deliveries.
* Load, unload, secure, and handle food and other materials safely and efficiently.
* Complete required pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspections and promptly report maintenance, safety, or repair needs.
* Maintain accurate transportation, inspection, and delivery records.

**Retail Partner & Customer Service:**

* Provide professional, respectful, and responsive service to local retail partners during scheduled pickups.
* Communicate expected arrival times, delays, and other delivery updates with retail partners and Community Food Center management.
* Build positive working relationships with retail partners, neighbors, volunteers, and ACFB team members.
* Represent the Atlanta Community Food Bank professionally while interacting with community partners and the public.

**Food Safety & Compliance:**

* Follow all ACFB food safety policies and procedures to protect product quality and ensure food is safe for consumption.
* Follow federal, state, and local transportation requirements, Department of Transportation regulations, and ACFB safety policies.
* Maintain all required licenses, certifications, vehicle documentation, and training.
* Report accidents, incidents, hazards, damaged product, or other safety concerns promptly and accurately.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and safe vehicle and work environment.

**Community Food Center Operations:**

* Support the daily operations of assigned Community Food Centers by coordinating the timely movement of donated products and materials.
* Work collaboratively with Community Food Center management, volunteers, and team members to support efficient loading, unloading, and delivery activities.
* Provide direction to volunteers and team members supporting loading and unloading activities
* Assist with operational activities as needed to ensure Community Food Centers receive products and materials in a timely and organized manner.

**Key Competencies we look for in All our Food Bankers are:**

* Customer Focus
* Decision Making
* Accountability
* The Ability to Navigate Change

If you’re excited about this role and can clearly demonstrate these and the other skills named below, we encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles!

**Skills your resume should demonstrate:**

* Valid driver’s license with a safe driving record.
* Experience operating non-CDL vehicles (box truck experience preferred).
* Ability to safely load, unload, and handle cargo.
* Basic knowledge of safe driving and transportation safety practices.
* Ability to complete vehicle inspections and report maintenance or safety issues.
* Ability to operate (or learn to operate) an electric pallet jack.
* Strong time management skills with the ability to meet delivery schedules.
* Experience in a fast-paced logistics, warehouse, retail, or food service environment.
* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Ability to follow food safety and workplace safety procedures.
* Ability to work independently and adapt to changing priorities.
* Ability to safely lift, move, load, and unload materials as required.

**There may be some Physical Demands and Travel:**

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Employee is routinely required to lift and transport heavy items at waist level, up to 75 lbs
* Frequent bending, stooping, reaching, climbing and walking are required
* Required to operate equipment
* This position would normally have routine opportunities to alter physical position or change eye focus.
* Frequently operates in temperature conditions consistent with outside weather.
* Frequently transition between ambient and refrigerator /freezer temperatures.
* This position requires local travel on a daily basis including routine stops which require driver to load and unload truck contents
